title: Low Space Race Demo
developer: Yuri Pourre, Marcelo Vianna, Nathan Badue, Serlof Music, Tiaggo Guimarães, Gregson Pereira

title: ZERO VISIBILITY Demo
description: Free demo of ZERO VISIBILITY. Survive your first three days in the fog-drowned suburbs and the hospital's ground floor. Scavenge, build up your base, take in survivors, and hold the line when the dead come for your base on night 3. Demo progress does not carry over.

title: PENNANT: Baseball Owner Demo
description: Play three full seasons of PENNANT for free. You own a baseball club: your front office runs it day to day, and every big call lands on your desk. Every rating you see is your scouts' guess. When the demo ends, your save carries into the full game.

title: Adunata Guest Edition
description: Adunata is a virtual tabletop that blends the depth of 3D with the speed of 2D tools. This free Guest Edition lets you join a friend's table using a seat from their copy, or try hosting a small table of your own. Already own Adunata? You join any table free.

title: Taskbar Garden Demo
description: A cozy idle garden that lives on your taskbar. Plant, pick and replant while you work, hatch a slime buddy that changes with every Seed, catch weather Mutations and finish Day 1's Garden Tasks. Everything you grow carries over to the full game.

title: Follyvale Demo
description: The demo of a wordless hidden-object puzzle game set inside living medieval paintings. Find what the villagers need, carry it across the scene and set their troubles right, and each one you mend brings the picture into full colour. No timers, no way to fail, and the Fool to help or get in your way.

title: Wave & Sort: The Magic Wand Shop Demo
description: You're locked in the last wrecked room of a wand shop. Flick your wand to read each wand's patron and wood, shelve 150 wands, put the room back together and calm the earth spirits. Restore the room and the master's wand is yours to try.

title: Island Sort Demo
description: Bring order to a messy island, one crate at a time. Island Sort is a relaxing sorting game for solo play, 3-player online co-op or 1v1 races. Try the Bakery, the Fruit Stand and the Workshop in this free demo.

title: Pimpin' Around Demo
description: Play as a pimp in the funky 1970s. Run the joint, slap the troublemakers and buy the place before the Pimp Boss buys you.

title: Sam, We Talked About This Demo
description: Every sentence, image and video on the internet will feed Sam's bottomless hunger! Train your models, grow your subscribers, buy new hardware and scrape even more data, all to build a super-duper artificial intelligence and leave every rival behind.

title: Abyssal Merge Demo
description: Abyssal Merge is a chaotic bullet heaven roguelite where multitasking is your only hope of survival. As a lone captain in a monster-infested ocean, you must fight off waves of enemies while simultaneously catching and merging the fish in your net to unlock game-breaking weapon synergies.

title: 莫比乌斯环Demo
description: A story-driven visual novel demo set in a fictional parallel universe, featuring branching storylines unlocked through player choices. This is an unofficial, free fan-made game created purely out of passion. All content is entirely fictional.

title: Virtualord, The Virtual Conqueror Demo
description: Set up your base, gather resources and build a defensive perimeter with walls and towers to protect your outpost from waves of enemies. Research new tech, gather your forces and send your units and mini-units to annihilate the enemy.

title: Suikandy Demo
description: Play the first two acts of Suikandy for free, the Suika-style sweet merging game with a roguelite twist. 10 levels, 17 utensils, the Daily Challenge and a taste of Tower Mode. Everything you earn carries over to the full game!

title: RuneEra Demo
description: RuneEra is a fantasy colony-management RPG where you build a guild settlement, automate work and production, equip powerful runes, and lead parties through a procedurally generated world of quests, factions, dangerous biomes, and dungeons.

title: Alone at Sea Demo
description: First-person lifeboat survival in the open Pacific. Salvage wreckage, spear fish and catch rain while thirst, fever, sharks and storms close in. No GPS. No compass to start: read the sun and stars with your own hand and steer for land you can't see. One life: when you die, the sea keeps you.

title: Scraplings Demo
description: Build a cozy, hand-drawn factory on an endless sea of trash. Dig up scrap, lay belts, power your machines and turn yesterday's garbage into orders worth paying the rent with. This free demo covers your first seven days on the junk sea.

title: BLACKROT Demo
description: BLACKROT is a fast-paced top-down action game of brutal dashes, parried bullets and random generated levels. Time only runs when you move. Dash through enemies, keep your combo going and paint the walls red.

title: Ayre Battles: Heritage Academy Demo
description: Ayre Battles: Heritage Academy is a tactical card fighter where positioning, reactions, Chains, Counters, and magical Junctions turn every hand into a duel. Build a 30-card deck, control range, steal momentum, and outplay your opponent one exchange at a time.

title: Kindling Hour Demo
description: A short psychological horror text adventure guided by a single candle. Random encounters and fragments of lost memories weave a story in the dark. Eerie and unsettling, yet a little cute and quirky. A narrative experience to gently light a fire in your heart.

title: Slumber Craft Demo
description: Try the free demo of Slumber Craft, a narrative deckbuilder about insomnia and self-repair. Shape your nights with daytime choices, then chain poker-style hands on the dream board to reclaim sleep across 14 sleepless nights. Sleep well enough, and a hidden deep-unconscious challenge awaits.

title: AGAIN: THE HALLWAY Demo
description: You follow the same path. Descend the same stairs. But each time you return, something has changed. Sometimes it's barely noticeable. Sometimes, something is terribly wrong. Nothing is quite as familiar as it seems and the truth waiting at the end may be closer than you think.

title: Katanakaji Demo
description: Become a Japanese swordsmith in this cozy first-person crafting game. Forge and customize unique katana, fulfill commissions, display or sell your work, and build your renown from an unknown apprentice to a legendary master.

title: The Real Guest Demo
description: Warning: Do not go outside. Keep your doors tightly shut. Pull the curtains closed. Only allow humans to enter. Eliminate all "impostors".

title: Ficciones//Nihility, Sea & Blissful Jellyfish
description: Xia Lin, a novelist raised in Chongqing, travels alone to the familiar seaside.Amid the crash of rolling waves, she is once again drawn back to that summer in August 2018.Through the eyes of the game's characters, you will piece together step by step a story that belongs to you and you alone.

title: Iron Maw Demo
description: Command the Iron Maw, an armored war train, against the Meridian Iron & Ordnance Company's Legions. Build a devastating convoy, crush colossal war machines, and defend the ten free cities that refuse to kneel.

title: Dungeonhand Demo
description: A single-player horror game about being hunted while you work. The contractors have given you 4 nights to dig your debt out of an ancient dungeon. Everything you are carrying is lost when you die, and every death costs you one of the nights.

title: Void Demolition Co. Demo
description: Play the first contract for free: tear down all of Woodland Town with the Lumber Axe, level up your black hole, awaken axe transmutations and watch the final devour.

title: RogueDesigner Demo
description: Ever wanted to be the game designer everyone loves to hate? Play as the notorious “RogueDesigner”, build relationships with your team, design characters, and choose between making a fair game or a money-making hit!

title: Touhou Reversal Demo
description: Unravel the truth behind her stolen power as Marisa Kirisame fights through endless bullet hell in this action hack and slash where every bullet can be turned against them.

title: Payload Architect Demo
description: An inventory-management auto-battler where your score grows exponentially. Arrange Code Blocks on a grid and let your program run itself. Find the loops and loopholes that push your Payload past every target.

title: 桌边小农场 Demo
description: Run a pixel farm on your desktop. Grow crops, hire farmers, raise chickens and arrange buildings your way. Assign farmers to sow, water and harvest, then sell crops to expand your land. Check in on the farm now and then while you work, study or take a break.

title: Planet Pilot Demo
description: Free demo of Planet Pilot. Learn to fly over Paris in a guided first flight, take your first jobs, fly through golden Sky Hunt rings and an airshow, then try Dogfights over the Moab canyons: flight school, a boss duel and a Legend battle. Your demo career carries over to the full game.

title: Phonophobia Demo
description: Awaken at an abandoned railway station in the Phonophobia Demo. Search for clues, solve tactile mechanical puzzles, and restore power to forgotten station. Every noise echoes with danger—survive the opening chapter.

title: 挂机伏魔录 Demo
description: Gather a party of wandering heroes and follow a path of cultivation and demon slaying. Build your team with combat styles, talents, manuals and equipment, then take on haunted mountain trails, secret-realm bosses and an endless tower in this single-player Chinese fantasy idle RPG.

title: Star-Soldier Demo
description: This is a sample of the main game. You get 24 levels, of the coming soon retro classic. Which has 114 levels! of action packed arcade fun.

title: Expendable Drillers Demo
description: Play the first two mine sites of Expendable Drillers for free. Dig a mining base deep under Mars, build rooms for a crew of hopeless tiny miners, and keep them fed, rested and breathing while the shuttle comes and goes. Simple to start, full of cartoon mishaps.

title: Pixel Sorter Factory Demo
description: First day at the factory: extract pixels, sort them, sell them. Then let the machines take over, until the factory runs itself. A blend of clicker, incremental gameplay, and pixel art… with a touch of mystery: where do all those pixels go?

title: Fish Party Demo
description: A one-button party game for 1 to 12 players in which you and your friends form a chaotic aquatic ecosystem. Play online or local multiplayer as unique fish in distinct ecosystems inspired by real reefs, beaches, and more across the world!

title: Meet Again: Heartwell Demo
description: Meet Again: Heartwell is a story-driven romance and life sim where you customize the protagonist, explore an island town, reconnect with an old crush, and work at a cozy café.
developer: Alien Puppy Games, Sad Slime Games

title: Everybody Hates You in TOKYO Demo
Project ReMind Demo
developer: Red Hog Studio, Full Dive Games

title: 逃脱:别听见  ESCAPE:DO NOT HEAR Demo
Don't Drop It Demo
description: Play the harbor chapter of Don't Drop It with a friend: the training pier and every section up to the last bridge. Pass the core, beat the hazards and see if your crew can make it without dropping it.

title: 007 First Light Free Starter Pack
description: Get the 007 First Light Free Starter Pack, and step into the world of espionage for FREE. Experience the opening chapter in Iceland, and discover the beginnings of this re-imagined origin story of James Bond.

title: Just One Grab Demo
description: Clock in, grab one. Free time, grab one. Before bed, grab one — live to ninety-nine. Wake up, grab one — luck comes with you. A brand-new treasure-digging game: easy to pick up, with a special digging twist, and different characters to try.

title: Roselle Hunt Demo
description: Step into the shoes of a bounty hunter in a PvPvE backpack auto-battler. Combine and upgrade gear, obliterate your foes, and... Find Roselle.

title: TBS: TASK BAR SURVIVOR Demo
description: A relaxing pixel-art desktop survivor demo. Grow your hero across 5 levels, stack weapon boxes, equip each box with an auto-firing weapon, merge upgrades, build your arsenal, and fight different enemies and powerful bosses.

title: The Count is Down for Blood Demo
description: The Count is Down for Blood is a gothic grid-based puzzle game where every move brings sunrise closer. Plan each step, drink blood, use vampire powers, and reach your coffin before the night runs out.

title: Cozy Cargo Demo
description: Play the Cozy Cargo demo for free! Someone's having a bad week. Your job is to pack them a comforting package. A cozy roguelike where every object reacts to the ones beside it, so you really don't want the scented candle next to the old novels. Three parcels each day, Monday to Friday.

title: No Refunds Demo
description: Free demo of No Refunds — a 1–4 player co-op home-shopping show. Play the first three chapters at the flea market and the short-form studio, lie on air, dodge the buzzer, and try the Spy mode with friends.

title: Captain Contraption’s Safari Park Demo
description: A pixel-art roguelite safari park sim. Clone lions, medieval knights and sentient trucks into a park with no fences, then route your visitors past the chaos. You control the paths, the buildings and your robot staff. The one thing you don’t control is the animals.

title: Splitter Demo
description: Try Splitter's free demo: shoot or slice through swarms of shapes, spend the pieces on permanent upgrades and take on six boss machines across chapters 0–5. Both modes share your progress.

title: Zero Hour Deadfront Demo
description: A cooperative zombie game for four players with roguelite elements. Choose cards between waves, survive hordes of ice, fire, lightning, or rock, and endure Zero Hour: every five x, the power goes out, a boss appears, and you must defeat it. Since this is a demo, gameplay is limited.

title: Furniture Store Simulator Demo
description: Open your furniture store. Order, unpack and place the LOFT Living Room collection, set your prices, then ring up customers. For a piece of furniture, fetch the box and hand it over at the pickup counter. Your reputation follows their reviews.

title: Code Fragment Demo
description: Explore a corrupted digital world in Code Fragment, a 2D puzzle-platformer. Run, jump, and evade hazards, uncover hidden paths, and use visual logic blocks to change rooms, reveal secrets, and find new ways forward.

title: My Hockey Story Demo
description: Play Season 1 of My Hockey Story for free. Train a young hockey player, learn tactics with your coach, and make quick decisions during matches. Develop your skills through training drills, mini-games, and your first season of competition.

title: Apartment 3502 | 3502号室 Demo
description: A psychological horror game set in a high-rise apartment building in Japan. You are staying in Room 3501 on the 35th floor when, one night, you encounter something inexplicable. Strange events gradually begin to unfold in what should have been a quiet apartment building...

title: 理货时光 Demo
description: Shelf Therapy Demo is a relaxing first-person 3D organizing game. Pick up scattered snacks, drinks, and everyday essentials, sort them onto the right shelves, and arrange each item your way. Transform a messy convenience store into a neat, satisfying space, one product at a time.

title: Void Revenant Demo
description: Take the Ghost through two sectors of pixel-art space combat. Collect salvage, upgrade at Vesk’s shop and break both bosses across four difficulty settings. A compact taste of Void Revenant’s branching routes, weapon builds and arcade scoring.

title: Upwardly Demo
description: Climb Dusk Spire in this free Upwardly demo! Conquer the same 500-meter tower section across three escalating difficulties: NORMAL, PUNISHER, and NOT GONNA HAPPEN. Master the obstacles, race against the clock, and see if you can survive all three climbs!

title: Seleka-san who Exposes unnoticed with Naked Coat Demo
Animal Bookshop: Tidy & Sell Demo
description: An animal themed book organizing game with customers, shop customization, and a whole lot of tidying!

title: Minesweeper Maker Demo
description: Minesweeper Maker is a grid based logic game where you can play and create countless puzzles with friends and the community.

title: Castle Wars: Legacy Demo
description: Build your castle to 100 or tear your rival's down to nothing in this medieval card battler. The free demo is the full free game: the six-chapter Season 1 campaign, online and AI matches, the world map, tournaments and events. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Too Many Roaches Demo
description: Free demo: the kitchen table at night. Switch on the light, aim, and your slipper swings on its own. Squash roaches until your nerves give out, buy the fly swatter when the flyers take off, beat Batya and see how many are still in the kitchen. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: CAPITALIUM Demo
description: Industrial-age economic and political sim. Open a workshop on loans and watch factories rise. Swallow rivals on the stock market, grip the nation's coal and iron, swing votes to shut competitors out. Court other capitalists, or crush them. Run rails to the frontier and found a town in your name.

title: Keystrike Demo
description: Action roguelike where power comes with a cost, a run comes with 250 possible upgrades, and every boss comes with 1000 bullets.

title: DomeLand Demo
description: Build your first geodesic home in the wilderness. Drive in, unload supplies, assemble the base and timber frame, then fit panels, a door and windows. This hands-on construction demo covers the first 1V dome cabin, a rainy night and the following morning.

title: Blood of Rome Demo
description: Lead a Roman legion through enemy hordes in a survivors-like where every level-up adds a new soldier. Evolve your troops, strengthen your general, and build an unstoppable army. Conquer for Rome.

title: Lennon and Luca Demo
description: Find healing from a mundane life by decorating the old house, all while playing personal babysitter for the 'little imp' in the mirror, helping him pass his boring days. In a sliver of frozen, misplaced time, you must find your own happiness.

title: One Last Cast Demo
description: A cozy pixel-art fishing game that lives on your desktop. Explore the first five locations in this demo, complete local commissions, upgrade your tackle, and discover rare color variants. Keep fishing and collecting after completing the demo’s objectives.

title: VCO: Victor Charlie One Demo
description: Experience battlefield command in this playable combat demo of VCO: Victor Charlie One, a convoy-driven tactical roguelite. Face overwhelming alien forces in explosive real-time battles. Assess threats and coordinate firepower on the fly, or pause to plan. Keep humanity's final weapon moving.

title: Bolt of Whalington Demo
description: A Metroidvania built around discovery and curiosity. Play as Bolt, a cat exploring a floating whale-city where you might melt walls with soap, become a rat to talk to enemies, or even hack the rules of the world. Explore, experiment, and uncover Whalington’s secrets. Curiosity doesn’t kill the cat.

title: The Elevator Demo
description: Confined in a vintage elevator, you must ascend 8 floors of an uncanny building. Study each hallway: press UP if normal, DOWN if altered. A tense psychological horror demo.

title: Jar of Gnomes Demo
description: The demo of Jar of Gnomes: your first hour in the allotment garden. Gnomlings pick berries and merge fruit in the magic cauldron up to the plum, and the Gnome Village has 20 nodes to unlock. Your save carries over to the full game.

title: The Fable of the Unlucky Clover Demo
萌塔物语 Demo
description: Monster girls are adorable—collect them all! Defeat monsters, possess their bodies, or capture them for your Body Vault. Switch forms to conquer the tower, then fuse, evolve, and teach skills to grow stronger bodies. Hunt rare, mutated, and prismatic variants. Start with a tower. Take every body!

title: Switch Girl: Special Rescue Beauty Demo
description: Creatures of the world are being corrupted by a dark nebula. Switch Girl, a living doll with the power of love and teleportation, devotes herself to protect the peace and bring love to everyone in a pacifist platformer game.

title: Roma 2443 - RTS
description: Roma 2443 demo

title: Midnight Rest Stop | 深夜ドライブイン Demo
description: A psychological horror game set at a roadside rest stop deep in the mountains of Japan. After your car breaks down, you stop there and end up spending the night at the adjoining lodging facility. But that night, strange things begin to happen...

title: DONT BE FOOL Demo
description: A 2-5 player online co-op puzzle platformer where nothing can be solved alone. Move and one button — that's all you get. Every level teaches one new rule, then asks you and your friends to survive it together.

title: Void and Fighter Demo
description: Void and Fighter is an action-adventure with light loot. Keep leveling up, and freely combine skills, passives, gems, and equipment into a build that is yours alone. Challenge ever deeper darkness in the Void.

title: Abyss Saga Demo
description: Abyss Saga is a fantasy dungeon-crawling JRPG. Summoned to another world, meet 9 unique companions, solve puzzles, hunt treasure, and explore the perilous Abyss. Mix classes, build your party, battle over 100 types of monsters, and uncover the secrets behind this vast chasm.

title: Desktop Gugu: Cozy Idle Pet Demo
description: Desktop Gugu Demo lets you care for two tiny desktop workers. Derpquack mines crystals and Leafbud Gugu gathers timber from a lasting divine tree. Collect and sell resources, recruit, build, and finish six demo goals in English or Simplified Chinese.

title: Ghost Haunting Demo
description: A classic 2D point-and-click adventure in glorious low resolution! Puzzle yourself through a world full of ghosts, monsters and pixelated mischief to rescue Gigi's grandmother from the realm of the dead. A heartwarming story about growing up, death, and how the two are connected…

title: Can Love Save Me? Demo
description: Meet Ai in a moonlit library. Build romance or friendship through conversation. This visual novel demo includes the complete prologue, expressive CG artwork, text in seventeen languages, and Japanese or English voices.

title: Dead After Dark Demo
description: Play the Community Center scene from Dead After Dark in Arcade Mode. Grab your light gun or mouse, blast through hordes of zombies, chase a high score, and discover interactive surprises hidden in the environment.

title: Multi Purpose Wheel Incremental Demo
description: Rotate everything in this new spin on the Incremental genre! Rotate satisfying contraptions to earn interconnected currencies. Upgrade the contraptions to earn more, earn faster, and earn whackier. Unlock new contraptions to expand your rotating horizons.

title: SAMOPAL Protocol Demo
description: A story-driven retro FPS. Fight through industrial zones, the districts of a dead city, and experimental areas to recover your memories and uncover the bloody truth of SAMOPAL Protocol.

title: The Rookie Prince's Defense Trials　TRIAL
description: You are the prince of a small kingdom. Defend its castles from monsters in this tower defense game!

title: Second Heart Demo
description: Run a covert-ops organization from the director's desk. Bio-engineer and arm superhuman agents in the lab, then deploy them and watch every mission unfold live through their eyes. Every heartbeat and bullet is simulated. Take the world one contract at a time.

title: A Witch's Husband Demo
description: The opening of A Witch's Husband. Spar with your father-in-law at the croft, wake in your own blood after the raid, and fight three sword duels on a Highland pass: block and strike from three directions, parry at the last moment, break your enemy's guard.

title: マジッククリッカー Demo
Somebody's Home: The Boarding House Demo
My Name Is Vincent Pogo Demo
description: Welcome Pogo Pals - It is Time!!! In My Name Is Vincent Pogo Demo, you’ll have the chance to explore an early portion of the game! Check out the store page for more information about what the game is about! Remember, It's not so hard!

title: Falling Apart Demo
description: Falling Apart Demo is a ~20-minute preview of the upcoming disturbing point-and-click puzzle-adventure about a man who, under hypnosis, descends into his fractured mind.

title: Refracted Demo
description: Try Refracted, a 4-player co-op shooter where you build turrets and lead troops. Wield crystal powers against the clanker horde in the Desert, unlock all four heroes, and play solo or with up to 3 friends online or over LAN. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Grimvale I [Demo]
description: Grimvale I is a first-person psychological horror game about a family hiding a dark secret. Explore an abandoned construction site, uncover clues through notes and journals, and piece together the truth. Your choices and discoveries shape one of three possible endings.

title: Hellobnb Demo
description: Play the opening chapter of HelloBnb Simulator: renovate a run-down house on a Greek island, turn it into a vacation rental, welcome guests and start your beach business. Wishlist the full game!

title: Ultimate Jello Party Demo
description: Ultimate Jello Party is a multiplayer party game that combines elements of card, board and minigame battles. Earn coins, plan your strategy and accumulate Jellos to win this chaotic competition full of nostalgic parodies for up to 4 players!

title: EZY Virtual TableTop Builder Demo
description: Join tabletop games for free as a player or spectator with EZY Virtual TableTop Builder Demo. Enter a full-version host's room code and play in 2D. Rules, character sheets and game materials come from the host; no module installation is needed.

title: D6scend Demo
description: Experience D6SCEND, a 3D puzzle game where every move counts. Roll a six-sided die through increasingly challenging, multi-level mazes, mastering spatial reasoning and orientation to reach each goal with the correct face up.This free demo features a limited selection of mazes showcasing D6SCEND’s core gameplay mechanics.

title: Save the Nuke! Demo
description: Save the nuke.....with a gun!

title: Feed The Pond Demo
description: Hire frogs, brew potions and feed a Wart that is never, ever full. Turn a quiet little pond into a bubbling swamp machine in this cozy incremental game.

title: 江湖一牌：无情武林 / Ace of Jianghu Demo
DiscPods Demo
description: Pilot a DiscPod, a small hover-robot that leaves a solid trail behind it. Touch any trail and you're out! Cut rivals off, slip through the gaps of the trails and shoot discs or bounce them off to take them out. Up to 8 players online, or against AI, a really Super-Intelligent AI...

title: Meowzic Survivor Demo
description: A rhythm-integrated roguelike that fuses survivor-style gameplay with dynamic music mechanics. Your firepower flows directly from the rhythm, meaning your combat build is also your custom game music. It’s time to conquer the universe with your own rhythmic symphony of destruction!

title: 颠倒志怪 Demo
description: Upside Down Tales of the GrotesqueSubtitle:​​ She takes the brush to rewrite the world.Intro:​​Demons and spirits run rampant in the mortal realm, yet the age-old tales of the grotesque have long silenced vibrant female voices. They wait for salvation, shatter over unfaithful lovers, remain earthbound by doomed passions...

title: Keep Making Games Demo
description: Tycoon for a one-person game studio, starting in 1976. Your only staff: a talking cassette, a bonsai and a chick with a megaphone. Unrealistic, I know. So is taking on the whole games industry alone for 50 years, and that's the plan. Build games from features, beat rivals to the shelves.

title: Beyond Solar Demo
description: Your first flight into Beyond SolarFight through the first six campaign missions, try different weapons and drones, and test your endurance in Survival mode. Between battles, visit your own Housing area and prepare for your next flight.What’s includedIntroductory training and the first six campaign missions.

title: Before it Falls Demo
description: Enter the long-closed St. Elora Hospital for a final technical inspection before demolition. Restore power, explore the building, and examine the records left behind. Before it Falls is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

title: Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon Demo
Trophy Rex Demo
description: A retro first-person dinosaur hunting game. Stalk 31 species across 9 hunting grounds, read the wind, choose your rifle and place the shot that reaches the heart. Wounded prey bleeds, runs or charges. Fly your trophies home to the lodge, or die out there and lose them all.

title: Cultivation: Alchemy Simulator Demo
description: **Cultivation: Alchemy Simulator** blends Chinese fantasy, incremental growth, management, and light roguelite elements. Grow spiritual herbs, refine pills, recover lost formulas, cultivate techniques, befriend fellow cultivators, and ascend toward immortality.

title: White Line North: Dog Sled Racing Demo
Celeforge Demo
description: Summon and merge random heroes to create mightier heroes and fend off incoming waves of enemies! Upgrade your heroes and discover diverse relics to forge your ultimate build! It's time to conquer the Abyss!

title: Contested Space: Core Defender Demo
description: The first pack opening defense game demo where you can play with friends! Crack booster packs to build your fleet, defend your core, and aim your own cannon while your stations fire. 1-4 player online co-op, short runs, hundreds of unlocks. Set in the Contested Space universe.

title: Island Escape Demo
description: A single-player 3D survival crafting game. Shipwrecked in 1907 on a nameless island, you gather, build, and push your civilization from stone to electricity — then build a boat and gamble on the open sea. Even a raft can leave; arriving alive is another matter. Sink, and the island is still yours.

title: Hetero-Genesis Demo
description: Grow a living weapon in this deep-sea action roguelite demo. Begin as an octopus, jellyfish, or sea snake; unlock the hermit crab. Graft organs, combine their abilities, evolve your body, and take on a complete ten-wave dive with three bosses.

title: Oddbat Demo
description: Have you ever wondered how vampires attain immortality? Become a bat, conquer flight with your flappy wings and perform a ritual unlike any other!

title: Privacy Not Included - A Motel Simulator Demo
Cruise Control Demo
description: Manage a cruise ship in this time-management strategy game! Build the dream cruise experience for your guests, work fast to solve problems, keep up with demand, upgrade your offerings to make every voyage even better, and keep the chaos from going overboard!

title: BOTCLOPS Demo
description: BOTCLOPS is an explosive 2-4 player co-op action puzzle game! Encounter various strange one-eyed robots, and use blocks to solve and survive the first 2 towers in this 8 level demo.

title: Print N Stick Demo
description: A cozy sandbox sticker game where you print, recolor, cut, and combine stickers to decorate different spaces. Create freely in Sandbox Mode, or share your creations on in-game social media, earn money, and expand your collection in Career Mode.

title: Pinewood Inn Demo
description: Pinewood Inn is a story-driven horror game in which you run a haunted hotel as its owner and try to scare your guests. But playing with fear spirals out of control!

title: Mombasa Conspiracy Demo
description: Join Connor O'Ryan and his inseparable friend Brian Moloney in a classic Point & Click thriller that will take them from the gloomy streets of Dublin to the sweltering heat of Kenya, where they will become embroiled in a conspiracy hidden in time.

title: Hairpin legends Demo
description: Play the free demo of Deslot Legends, a tabletop slot racing game where every millimeter matters. Master one-button driving, stay in the slot, push your car to the limit on three circuits, compete in your first Career cups, and carry your progress over to the full game.

title: Perfectly Folded Demo
description: Perfectly Folded is a cozy organizing game in a clothing store the cats have wrecked. Fold, hang and shelve every shirt, hat and shoe, catch the cats hiding in plain sight, then hire them to help you tidy up.

title: CottageCore Demo
description: Build your first cottages, add paths and ponds, and welcome villagers in this free CottageCore demo. Explore a small glade, discover five trades from farming to fishing, and enjoy village life at your own pace.

title: Azure Ruins Demo
description: Aside from two Relics, you can experience all the content of the full version in the trial version, and your progress in the trial will carry over to the full version.

title: Goods for Guilds Demo
description: Heroes go on adventures. You make sure they have swords, potions, and supplies. Command workers RTS-style to gather, haul, and process resources. Upgrade from hand-carrying to carts, and grow a production and trade network that keeps the adventurers' guild running.

title: Horror Vacui Demo
description: A short, replayable atmospheric horror game set on Jupiter's moon, Europa. Pilot the machinery of an old spacecraft, drill into the unknown, and find the origin of an alien signal. Don't fear the void.

title: Chair Chase Demo
description: Chase the chair before someone steals your seat! Chair Chase is a chaotic 2-8 player party game where living chairs run away from you. Jump, dash and push friends aside, then hold on tight to score. Most points after 7 rounds wins! Supports public matches and streaming.

title: Kingdoms Test Of Time Demo
description: A civilization builder from ancient times to the future, with 36 scenarios, space colonization, crusades, religious revolts, nuclear winter, climate change, dynamic world wars and extensive record keeping

title: DungeonVerse Demo
description: DungeonVerse takes you to four unique worlds that have been reduced to gloomy dungeons by a catastrophe. Explore crumbling ruins, mystical places and forgotten cities, battle powerful bosses and collect all the artefacts to restore balance to your world.

title: Marchling Idle Demo
description: Marchling Idle is an incremental idle game. Relax, grow a bigger and bigger army, and watch them crush the enemy.

title: In the Same Boat Demo
description: Embark on an adventure across the ocean! In this captivating cooperative sailing game, one player commands the ship, while the other is confined to the captain's cabin, solely navigating with the map. Successfully completing your missions will require the crew's adept communication and skill.

title: Gods to Dust Demo
description: The whole First Hour, free: six gates, four expeditions and nine boss fights across the Red Sands, ending at the Sealed Gate. Choose your weapon, walk the Night Wheel, and see how long the night lets you last.

title: Nexus Wars Demo
description: A free demo of the Nexus Wars character creator. Build your commander in a sci-fi space opera of nine warring factions: choose a faction and lineage, pick a portrait, set attributes and origins, cast your destiny, and review your starting fleet and army in 3D. Work is subject to change as EA

title: Pilot Tycoon Demo
description: Play your first week as a regional First Officer in Pilot Tycoon, a pilot career RPG. Bid for your schedule by seniority, handle in-flight emergencies through quick-time events, and manage money, stress and reputation. The full game takes your career all the way to mainline Captain.

title: SKULD Demo
description: Fight on the front line of your own defense. As Skuld, the Norn of fate turned Valkyrie, cut through waves of Hela's corrupted creatures in fast third-person combat while you place and upgrade turrets around you. A Norse action tower defense, set after Ragnarök.

title: Alarion: The Ruined King Demo
description: Alarion: The Ruined King is a dark fantasy action game. A dead king awakens through the power of his own blood and sets out across a demon-infested kingdom. unleash forbidden blood powers, battle deadly enemies and bosses, and face Malachar to end his reign.

title: THREADMILL Demo
description: Write one program for every worker. Grow a robot workforce, share jobs and keep it working through changing supply and power outages. This Demo includes the opening Campaign, The Pipeline and replayable Challenges.

title: Hide and Luig Demo
description: Hide & Luig is a playful, surreal point-and-click puzzle adventure about curiosity, absurdity, and one very elusive guy.Every episode drops you into a weird, beautifully crafted micro-world. Your mission? Simple: find Luig. The execution? A bit more chaotic. Luig doesn't hide behind trees or under blankets.

title: Roof UP! Demo
description: Build a cozy floating hex island where every building grows as tall as it is happy. Cottages love trees, windmills love fields, lighthouses love the sea. Place each piece where its neighbors lift it up, and watch your skyline climb through the seasons.

title: 璇玑貂蝉 Demo
description: Diaochan crossed two thousand years and landed on your desktop. A classical Chinese companion who lives in your computer — keeping you company while you work, slack off, and stay up late. She remembers your past talks. She talks back, out loud.

title: Little Kitty ,big adventure: Demo
description: "TONGTONG：Little Kitty ,big adventure" is a pixel-art action platformer akin to Metroid and Castlevania. Guide kitten TONGTONG to run, jump, climb, and glide through interconnected areas, unlocking abilities to forge unknown paths amid heartwarming yet perilous adventures.

title: TianJin1924 demo
description: Tianjin, 1924. In a city of treacherous undercurrents, where foreign powers vie for control, your legend begins. Befriend heroes, master a trade, and forge your own destiny.

title: SHRED A BILLION Demo
description: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them up with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 3,929,120,202 bills left to collect!

title: High Wizards Demo
description: A chaotic first-person co-op roguelite for 1 to 8 players. Play as a floating wizard head: fire spells from your finger gun, stack modifiers into absurd wand combos, hit your weed pen to get blazed, and survive two lands that loop back harder every time. Free demo with its own leaderboards.

title: The Devil Upstairs Demo
description: Try The Devil Upstairs for free. Stomp to the beat with F and J, recruit noisy devils, and turn each run into permanent upgrades. Descend through a mischievous apartment building in this single-player rhythm incremental demo.

title: Lost in the Desert with Giant Spiders Demo
Art Fraud Demo
description: Four to eight pub animals share one canvas and one secret word — all except the Art Fraud, who has no idea what everyone is drawing. One stroke each, then 90 seconds of voice chat to find the liar. Point, vote, unmask. The loser gets tomatoes.

title: You Can't Drink Gold Demo
description: Dig through the first 13 layers of an active incremental mining roguelite. Unearth treasure, socket gems into your gear and find the first of six buried keys. Just don't miss the water bill, because you can't drink gold.

title: Dungeon Stage Demo
description: Try a solo tabletop-style RPG with an AI dungeon master. Create your hero, describe your actions, meet companions, and fight tactical battles on an illustrated fantasy stage. Explore the core adventure in this free demo; character leveling is disabled.

title: Radical Moves 2 Demo
description: It's a fun cartoon-style game with Rob, being the radical dude at the centre of the action. With a Wham!, Bam! and Kabam! Rob takes on all comers to fight his way to the bitter end. Hot on his heels are several meanies all with one thing on their mind - Robs Downfall!!!.

title: The Car Game - Play with friends
description: A funny racing game with 2000's like handling of cars and 90's graphics.

title: Momentigrade Demo
description: A fast-paced 3D Metroidvania with a focus on stylish, momentum driven movement. Chain together jumps, dashes, backflips, and pole swings as you explore a colorful interconnected city. Fight creatures, discover secrets, and see how long you can keep the flow going.

title: The Archivist Demo
description: The Archivist is a psychological horror game set inside a research facility consumed by the Backrooms.

title: 烬环诸域 Demo
description: Begin your journey in this free pixel-art fantasy RPG demo. Gather resources, craft equipment, trade in harbor settlements and prepare for automatic combat. Choose from five origins and conquer the Sunken Bell Cellar to finish the demo. Uses separate save files.

title: 我在乱世当流民 Demo
description: A civilian survival sim in a collapsing dynasty. Chop wood, break rocks, pick herbs, farm — but this is no cozy farming game. Fight tooth and nail for every grain of food. Villagers aren't there to be befriended: only barter, deceit, robbery. To survive, will you do wrong — or stay human?

title: SqueeGee: Window Cleaning Simulator Demo
description: SqueeGee is a cozy window cleaning game where you ride a gondola up towering skyscrapers and make every pane sparkle. Spray, squeegee and scrape away the grime, upgrade your gear, unlock abilities and robot helpers, and spot sightings from the top in a no pressure, no rush world.

title: Feed The Lone Bastion Demo
description: An Incremental-Ish game about evolving The Bastion.

title: Totally Invited: Party Heist Simulator Demo
It Takes One To Gnome It All Demo
Goblin Kaboom Demo
description: A fast-paced casual auto battler. Raise your army, fortify your base and watch invading monsters splatter upon your defenses.

title: Hive and Harvest Demo
description: Death is dying, and five hives are fighting over the rot that's left. A trading card game about insects you grow from parts, a card at a time. Plant a parasite in an enemy creature, seed it with spores until it changes sides, or just break it and race your opponent to the pieces.

title: 1Million Tiles Demo
description: A tiny tile workshop that lives above your taskbar. Build belts and machines that press, saw, glaze and inlay ceramic tiles, then fire them in the Kiln. Hover to check in. Get back to work and it keeps firing.

title: Eldritch Drift Demo
description: A cartoon-goth kart racer where drifting wakes the gods. Forge runes into spells, blast rivals with plasma, rift bombs and walls, and race six ghoulish drivers through a haunted mansion and a temple adrift between worlds, alone or in 2-4 player split-screen.

title: Cravecrops - Farming Defense Demo
description: Grow suspicious experimental plants by day and defend your plantation from hordes of addicted animals by night. Sell your harvest, upgrade your defenses, and expand your operation in this farming defense roguelite.

title: One Hit Hero Demo
description: One Hit Hero is a boss-rush action game where any hit is fatal, for you and your foes alike. Read attack patterns, block, parry, and dodge to build the power to slay each boss with one decisive strike. Trapped in a sealed dungeon, you must prove yourself by defeating every boss to earn your escape.
developer: Glitch Pixel Interactive, Low Tech Studios

title: Internet Provider 98 Demo
description: Bring the world online in an idle incremental game with a retro ’90s desktop aesthetic. Send data packets, upgrade your hardware, automate your network, and speed up research with an icon-matching minigame. Grow from your first customers to a global internet provider.

title: What Da Font: Tidy Up the Print Shop
description: The free demo of a cozy first person organizing game, with the whole 1920s print shop open. Thieves turned over every case: explore both floors, read the lead to tell one typeface from another, put up to 1,000 sorts back where they live, then set and print posters by hand on the press.

title: Mox Nox Demo
description: Unleash Mox Nox's ferocious combat system: precision swordplay, reactive enemy AI, brutal dismemberment, and advanced blood physics. Deflect arrows, command phantom allies, challenge devastating bosses, and become an unstoppable force in Purgatory's endless Gauntlet!

title: Star Eden: here sleep angels Demo
100 Bodies in the Grass Demo
description: 100 Bodies in the Grass is a wave-based co-op defense game, set against the backdrop of the Third Mongol Invasion of Vietnam, combining elements of roguelikes and tower/hero defenses with the combat of an isometric ARPG. Demo includes the first 5 waves.

title: A Spiritual Adventure Demo
description: Welcome to A Spiritual Adventure! A free choice-driven text adventure where the experience revolves around what you want to do as opposed to a specific narrative, sort of. There are hundreds of choices to make, with many minigames and other cool bits to experience.

title: Steam Colony Demo
description: Build a steampunk colony, automate gathering with robots and defend your Core. This free demo includes technology through tier 2, with steam storage and steam turrets, and no time limit. Help us find bugs using the report option in the game menu.

title: Detective Defective: The Insider Demo
description: A rookie fraud becomes a private detective to uncover the truth behind his wife’s murder. Investigate crime scenes, connect hidden clues, and be careful—missing one detail may change what you understand later.

title: The #1 Game Company  Demo
description: If you love games and never stop pushing forward,then The #1 Game Company is where you belong.

title: Ink Left Demo
description: You are a stick figure on an unfinished page, abandoned mid-stroke. Draw bridges, ropes, springs and mirrors with the ink the artist left behind — every line obeys real physics. Slip past crossed-out beasts across fading paper. Ink runs out. In the end, you will have to erase part of yourself.

title: Unhappening Demo
description: Navigate a collapsing world where light is your only protection. Solve physics-based environmental puzzles with the help of temporary companions, and survive the darkness consuming fractured memories of humanity’s final survivor. For fans of Inside, Limbo, and Little Nightmares.

title: Night of Vargold Demo
description: Hunt wolves that devour the night in a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where cards become buildings. Enemies attack both you and the board. Read their attack zones, place your buildings, and turn even their destruction into part of your strategy.

title: FPS Performance Lab Demo
description: Free demo of FPS Performance Lab. Take the short mouse aim test (about 5 min), see your score, your number one priority and the evidence behind it, then play a 60-second Flick round. Not a game, not an FPS booster.

title: Sorcerech Demo
description: This is Demo for Sorcerech. It is a 2D Pixel Metroidvania where you switch between unique magic and cybernetic forms, battle enemies, solve puzzles, and make choices that shape your journey toward multiple endings.

title: MORTISCRIPT: Undead Auto Battler Demo
description: Program the behavior of your undead army and watch your orders unfold in MORTISCRIPT: Undead Auto Battler, a dark fantasy strategy RPG. Rebuild your manor, conquer hostile regions, and refine your rules through trial and error until the dead obey.

title: Grimlane Demo
description: Grimlane is a tower defense game with cards. Build and upgrade towers, fight waves of monsters, and develop your economy. Use cards from your deck to construct buildings, activate abilities, and strengthen your defense.

title: Take That Shot Demo
description: You're a basketball. Roll, charge-jump and dash up a tower of floating junk, squash your friends on the way, and try to sink a shot at the top. Up to 8 players with voice chat.

title: Rip It Together Demo
description: Free demo: play the first day of Rip It Together solo or with up to 3 friends. Win mystery packages at the auction, then rip, pop, squish and smash your way to the prize. Supercar or poo?

title: Nine Tails, Ten Nights Demo
description: A choice-driven Seoul noir mystery. A fox-spirit investigator becomes a murder suspect as the D-10 countdown begins. Play Episode 1 as Baek Yeoul, compare evidence, choose whom to trust, and keep your hunger in check.

title: Twin Drive Demo
description: Two players. One car. One drives the front, the other drives the rear. Work together to go straight! Play this free demo with a friend and race up to 4 cars to the finish.

title: Scent of You Demo
description: A cozy free demo of Scent of You: tend the quiet perfume shop you inherited and blend scents for customers who can't quite name what they miss. Listen closely, open a drawer of keepsakes, and bottle one memory in three notes.

title: VoxelMine Demo
description: The free demo of VoxelMine. Mine, forge your own tools at the anvil, hunt, farm, and take on the bosses when you’re ready. Playable in both survival and creative mode.

title: My Boba Shop Simulator Demo
description: Run your own bubble tea shop! Start small, make drinks, manage ingredients and inventory, develop new recipes, and expand your menu. Decorate and expand your shop, earn money, unlock new content, and grow your business step by step.

title: The Fight Business Demo
description: Build your MMA gym in this single-player management demo. Recruit fighters, negotiate contracts, develop prospects, hire coaches and prepare your stable for fight night. Manage the risks inside and outside the cage across 12 in-game weeks of The Fight Business.

title: So Many Cats! Demo
description: Turn piles of plush cats into tidy shelves! In the So Many Cats! demo, sort 768 plushies from one aisle's 4 cat families, carry 4 giant cats to their cushions and unlock your first skills. No timers, no rush. Just one more cat!

title: The Deep Rises Demo
description: A roguelite auto-battler where the final boss is on the map from your first step, walking toward you. Every step you take brings him closer. Build a kit that fights on its own, save the villages in his path, and face him with everything you saved, and everything you didn't.

title: Seagrid Nightfall Demo
description: Free demo. Command three pirates fighting to see dawn in a turn-based tactical roguelite. Read enemy attacks, shove foes into each other or overboard, and turn the Storm King's power against his own minions. Keep your battered ship sailing across a dead ocean.

title: The Mofu Game Demo
description: The Mofu Game is a psychological horror visual novel about a cursed story that should never have been read. Proceed at your own risk.

title: Unwanted Host Demo
description: Survive a live torture show where a parasite is trying to kill you in this strategy roguelite. Heal your body, search for the invader, and kill it with a well-placed injection, all while managing the time left until the parasite retaliates. Indulge your viewers long enough to reclaim your freedom.

title: EMZOMBED 3 Demo
description: 69 Years have passed since the events of the first 2 games. You and a ragtag group of misfits must struggle to survive zombies and bandits across many challenging levels.

title: RYFT STRIKE: BRIGHTER TOMORROW Demo
description: Three nights before her war goes on television, Lt. Vesper is found by a Halcyon nature documentary. A complete prologue mission for the bullet-hell shoot 'em up: spell-card bosses, focus and graze scoring, a submarine carrier the size of the screen, and couch or online co-op.

title: The Planewalker's Guild Demo
description: Lead a guild of adventurers in this turn-based tactics roguelite. Recruit heroes, build your party, and spend action points on powerful abilities as you explore dangerous dungeons. Every expedition ends in glory or a grave.

title: TaskBar Gambler Demo
description: Try TaskBar Gambler free! A tiny idle slot machine that lives on your taskbar and spins while you work. Every win hits the House. Climb 55 floors, hire a crew and beat the pit bosses.

title: Save Me My Hero Demo
description: ’Save Me, My Hero’ is a defense game with roguelike elements.Complete your own battle style with the hero's various skills and special abilities.

title: Walter? Demo
description: Help a mysterious she-wolf, summoned from the world of the dead, return to her eternal rest. Destroy figures from literature and folklore in turn-based combat through a simple yet brutal memory game.

title: Bold Hole Demo
description: An unfinished free demo in active development. Grow a black hole on a tiny planet, swallow objects, choose upgrades and dodge danger. Play Earth up to level 16 with the fiery accretion-disk style. Other styles, Free Mode and the Workshop are reserved for the base game.

title: 777 HERO ~The One Who Defies Time~ Demo
This Is the Peace (Demo)
description: One shift. Seven seats. Far too many egos. Try the first day of this satirical dispatch strategy: build your team, handle 15 calls, open diplomatic talks, and discover why the President's phone is everyone's problem.

title: 边线资本 Demo
description: Build your football agency in the TOUCHLINE CAPITAL demo. Scout and sign players, assign agents, and develop promising talent. Balance opportunities with limited resources as you decide which players to back and how to grow your business.

title: The Last Vending Machine Demo
description: The world ended. One vending machine is still waiting for power. Crank it to life, sell water, coffee and seeds to survivors, and watch a settlement grow around the only light for miles. A cozy post-apocalyptic incremental game.

title: I Just Wanted to Fish Demo
description: A stranger, a fishing rod and an island full of closed paths. Fish, explore and help the people you meet until every shore is yours to fish.

title: Crypto in a Haystack Demo
description: Try the demo: Search a mountain of discarded hardware for wallets holding fictional BiteCoin. Play alone or with up to three friends, scan your finds, upgrade your gear, build shared production lines, explore locked rooms, and fend off thieves in a first-person salvage game.

title: Seaside Shop Simulator Demo
description: Grow your very own seaside shop! Sell products, earn profits, expand your store, plan the layout, and experience the journey of building a successful business from the ground up.

title: BlastMorph: Pinball Demo
description: I took pinball and VIDEO-GAMIFIED it! Where else can you play video game bonus stages and play from INSIDE the pinball table!?

title: 冰箱爷爷的一天 Demo
description: Everyday pomodoro timers are too plain — this is a pomodoro timer game packed with all kinds of 90s lifestyle elements.

title: Lyra Mahjong manager
description: "Lyra Mahjong Manager" is a career simulation game for professional mahjong players. Players will oversee a mahjong team, and a mahjong players, experiencing the full spectrum of mahjong league matches.

title: Backwatt Demo
description: Free demo of Backwatt, a co-op action roguelite for 1–4 players. Stuff your backpack with guns: tesla coils need juice from a generator, shotguns just need room. Spring, summer and autumn are in — winter comes later.

title: 天空のミーニャ Demo
description: You’ll control Minya as she takes on the graduation exam at Sky Magic Academy, aiming to pass the exam and graduate. If you defeat a host of enemies and take down the final boss, Minya will graduate successfully. This game focuses primarily on third-person combat and treasure hunting.

title: Frogball Demo
description: Classic 90's GameBoy style Pinball... this time with frogs! Compete against your friends and the world for the highest scores on 8 unique, interlinked pinball tables. It's fast, fun and impossible to put down!

title: Logosmancer Demo
description: Free demo of Logosmancer. Cast every spell with your voice: say FIREBALL, FREEZE, FLY, TRANSFORM or FART. Play King of the Hill online with friends and the full co-op Sandbox mode on Sands of Kheperu, and level your wizard up to 10.

title: GG Land: Build & Play
description: A game where building is fun and easy. Featuring a challenge mode to truly test your skills in building! Once you are done, you can share your creation with your friends and see if they can beat your time!

title: Tidy Up Ltd.: A Cozy Co-op Cleanup Demo
Eat Everything in a Supermarket Demo
Runaway Rocket Demo
description: Your rocket blasts into the sky — but the monster could turn around at any moment! Time your landing, build up the target prize, and push your limits!

title: Global Protocol: New World Order Demo
description: Command any of 261 real-world countries in this 2026 grand strategy game. Build your economy, lead armies, and navigate deep diplomacy. Features built-in modding support and 12 supported languages. Shape the global order through espionage, nuclear deterrence, and AI-driven geopolitics.

title: Siege of Nightmares Demo
description: Descend into the nightmare. Action Roguelike Tower Defense, defeat the Boogeyman as he attempts to place phycological horrors on your child.

title: Industrial Luck Defense Demo
description: A free solo tower defense demo with heavy machinery and a fictional investment market. Draw, place, and merge rigs; take extra workloads for bigger payouts; and grow a small construction company without letting the site overflow.

title: Snow White and the Dwarf Slaves Demo
description: This demo lets you play through the outcome of the first tribute in Year 10.

title: Eternal Solitude Demo
description: ETERNAL SOLITUDE is a new turn-based 4X fantasy game, set in the World of Eternal Solitude combining deep racial society development, empire and city building, tactical combat, spells, espionage with far-reaching consequences of every decision. Become the true magic overlord, or die as a slave!

title: Death Pool Club Demo
description: Oh, a new face? Welcome to Death Pool Club. Every ball you sink takes a bite out of your rival's health. But we share the table, darling. Whatever you leave lying around is mine next turn ♠ The pockets are shady and the executives cheat openly. Beat them all, if you can.

title: BackToThreeKindomsDemo
description: Back To Three Kingdoms is a turn-based tactical wargame .You play as a food delivery man who travels back to the the Three Kingdoms period. Assemble an army led by three powerful generals to take on a series of distinct levels . Unlock more unique generals and formidable equipment as you progress.

title: アヤカシプロファイル Demo
Blooming Courtyard Demo
description: Blooming Courtyard is a cozy logic puzzle game on a grid. Follow the placement rules to solve hundreds of puzzles. Enjoy the scenery of all four seasons as you fill your little sunlit courtyard with flowers and greenery!

title: Buildot Demo
description: Help Buildot save the world of Godot from the tyranny of the Unreal Union! Solve clever puzzles using diodes, logic gates, and conveyor belts. Beware of slippery surfaces and ice, where a single move can change everything. The demo contains 20 handcrafted puzzle levels.

title: A Red Specter Haunts the World – Free Sample
description: Build a highly organized Communist Party with iron discipline; seize power through armed struggle; liberate all oppressed people; and march toward the fulfillment and realization of the Party’s highest goals and ultimate ideals

title: The Hollow Grounds Demo
description: Survive relentless waves of the Hollowed, upgrade your armor and home, unlock and level up powerups, and invest Soulstones into permanent upgrades. Rebirth to grow stronger, fight deadly bosses, complete 50 achievements, explore the Enemy Index, and climb the leaderboards!

title: Champion Tennis Demo
description: Try Champion Tennis, a single-player 3D tennis game with special powers. Charge your returns, choose skill cards and evolve your build through cups against computer rivals. Finish the City Open Cup, return home and keep playing. Demo progress uses a separate save.

title: Boom or Bloom Demo
description: Free demo of Boom or Bloom: play up to Night 5, solo or with up to 3 friends. Every extra scoop makes the shell bigger and brighter - and more likely to blow the whole workshop sky-high.

title: Hallow's Eve Demo
description: Are you ready to start Jack's Tale? Then let us begin with Hallow's Eve

title: Service, please Demo
description: Manage and decorate your hotel, cook for your guests, clean their rooms, park their vehicles, and carry out mafia assignments while paying off your debts to them. Do you think you can handle it all? Featuring Music by Matthew Pablo

title: Slender Island Demo
description: Slender Island is a first-person survival horror game where you find yourself on an abandoned island with a goal of stealing all the treasures hidden in its dungeons. However, Slender Mouse and other monsters won't give them up without a fight.

title: Mummy's Escape Demo
description: Play the early levels of this puzzle-adventure. Explore ancient crypts, solve challenging 3D puzzles, and outsmart the tomb's security. A small taste of the challenges waiting for you in the full release.

title: Stay in Your Lane: Demo
description: Buck had a revelation: whatever waits at the end of the road, he has to reach it.The road is narrow, and it is never empty. Rivals, armies, and old enemies stand in Buck's way, each determined to make him turn back. But turning back is no longer an option.

title: 边境机甲：界外 Demo
description: Frontier Mech: Beyond is a sci-fi mech action shooter. Pilot a mech and battle insect swarms and enemy mechs with firearms. This demo offers a taste of the game's core combat gameplay.

title: Heartreave Demo
description: The Heartreave demo: a turn-based hack-and-slash where every fight is played with cards. Assemble a party, solo or in online co-op, and craft unique builds by combining cards, passives, talents, relics, creature hearts and island hearts to find the best synergies.

title: Killer in a Corn Maze Demo
description: Play the killer. Or try to escape one. A top-down pixel horror game set in a corn maze on Halloween night.

title: UPG Cubed Demo
description: A fast-paced minimalist platformer where precision is everything. Master jumping, wall-jumping and dashing, collect diamonds, beat challenging levels and push your skills to the limit. And create your own levels in UPG Cubed

title: Click-A-Bao Demo
description: Click the buns, catch the buns, don't eat the buns. A hidden objects game where you don't have to find everything. Capture baonty cards that summon bun helpers that will find the hidden buns for you! Decorate your space, get new levels, upgrade your cards and collect them all!

title: Torreta Demo
description: Try Torreta up to wave 20.

title: Flesh Mill Demo
description: ENTER THE CAMP. FEED THE MACHINE. BECOME SOMETHING WORSE. Flesh Mill is an incremental horror RPG where prisoners are nothing but fuel for your ascent. Grow stronger, unlock grotesque upgrades, and face increasingly horrific bosses in brutal turn-based combat.

title: Sauna Grudge Demo
description: Step into the Finnish Sauna Tournament in this playable taste of Sauna Grudge, a single-player turn-based deckbuilding roguelite. Play as Pekka and tackle the first three stops: Helsinki, Kerava and Lahti. Build your hand, manage Action Points, switch benches, and outlast your rivals by wearing down their Sisu or Hapy.

title: Voiceless Demo
description: The first French POV slasher film in FMV, shot to keep you on the edge of your seat Voiceless is an interactive live-action slasher film designed as a faux single take: every decision is made in real time.

title: RichBashDemo
description: “RichBash” is an online party board game. Roll dice around the island to buy land, collect tolls, match with the Book of Fate and global events, and create famous scenes in small games. Support various fun outfits and stand up interactions. Suitable for friends to block and pit against each other

title: Diamond District: Jewelry Shop Simulator Demo
description: Buy gold, catch the fakes and flip the real pieces in the first days of your own jewelry shop in New York's Diamond District. Start with $1,000, stock silver and gold chains, haggle at the counter and meet a celebrity on day 4. Co-op for 1 to 4, and your shop carries over to the full game.

title: THUNDERBOLT Demo
description: THUNDERBOLT is a Roguelike Deckbuilder played on a tactical grid. Position yourself carefully and fight enemies room-by-room to escape the alien-infested Thunderbolt!

title: Potato Factory Demo
description: Run your own potato chip factory, from peeling by hand to full automation! Make chips, build production lines, and grow your business with robot helpers. Wait… are these chips headed for space?

title: Duck Duck Run Demo
description: The ducks are on the run, and you have 3 minutes to catch them! Chase them down as they try to escape. Catch ducks to earn coins and unlock new items and upgrades.

title: Feeding the Foxes Demo
description: The darkest horror visual novel you'll ever play. THEY. ARE. HUNGRY. Will you feed them?

title: Cleanup Crew: Biohazard Inc Demo
description: A horror cleanup FPS where you recover specimens, restore infected locations, and earn bonuses from a mysterious corporation conducting classified research.

title: Tidyspell Demo
description: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

title: Cat's Endless Stroll Demo
description: Pick a cat and a place, and a slow stroll begins. Wander through gently changing scenery as your cat grows, little by little, into a shape all its own. Keep it in a small window on your desktop while you work, or walk together with your Steam friends.

title: Scars of the Soul Demo
description: Free DEMO, about 1–2 hours. Play as Altos through a prison exploration stretch, try early Soul Orb builds, and face a triple-boss sequence. Top-down 2D pixel ARPG: Soulslike combat, Zelda-like / Metroidvania exploration.

title: Beyond Realm Demo
description: Beyond Realm is a roguelite deckbuilder set in two worlds: a kingdom drained to grey ink, and the wild, bright lands beyond its portal. One purse of gold for the whole expedition. What will your survival cost? The realm has lost its colours. A portal opened at its edge, and on the other side the world is still bright.

title: Underway: Tales Of A Killer
description: Some might say that "Underway" is basically a boss-rush fetch-quest. And while they might be right (if ALL of the story is ignored), what if there was a version that fit that inaccurate description a bit more? Well... Now there is. But not in the way you think...

title: MEOWBOUND LEGENDS Demo
description: MEOWBOUND LEGENDS is an idle RPG starring a cast of adventurous cats! A group of cats finds themselves transported to another world, where they build a village of their own. They'll head out to fight monsters, collect equipment, and grow stronger—all on their own.

title: Ichorous Demo
description: The blood-splattering roguelike where you shred through enemies infested with Ichor. Use the blood you spill to heal and grow stronger! As you collect ichor for the god of blood, known only as The Patron, he will grant you upgrades that not only help you but also your enemies!

title: Paper Physics Demo
description: Arrange and combine objects on paper to get the ball to the finish.

title: Club Sanguine Demo
description: Run the door at a nightclub for vampires in this darkly comedic first person deduction and management game. Inspect suspicious guests, expose impostors, dispose of troublemakers, and manage your very own den of the undead.

title: Employee06 Demo
description: An ordinary man finds himself trapped somewhere he was never meant to be. Uncover the mysteries of Blue Flame Laboratories in Employee06, a psychological horror game blending visual novel storytelling, security camera surveillance, and first-person horror.

title: Protos. Neural Collapse Demo
description: Free demo of PROTOS. Neural Collapse: third-person space combat. Fly early contracts, arm your ship, fight Corporate patrols, and evade spy drones that call reinforcements. Try the core loop before the full game.

title: Miredrift Demo
description: Play the opening chapter of Miredrift. Take your battered boat into a flooded, mutating swamp, follow a voice on the radio and fight the creatures that hunt the mire in packs. Three story quests, a side quest and a boss fight await.

title: Bastion Rivals Demo
description: Lead the Iron Covenant in a complete solo siege against AI. Build your base, choose your army's lanes and destroy the rival stronghold while troops march and fight automatically. The demo includes the faction's buildings and upgrades, three AI difficulties, save/load, local replays and battle review.

title: Catnip Wars Demo
description: Defend a catnip farm in this tower-defense demo. Build turrets, walls and generators as a scrap-metal Catbot, repair what the monsters break, and hold out solo through the first 20 waves. The full game adds online co-op for up to four players, endless waves and a Sandbox mode.

title: SCRATCH FEVER Demo
description: Scratch tickets, merge cash 2048-style, and set off chains of rockets, TNT, and lightning to afford your next ticket. Build broken combos with dozens of lucky charms in a neon-soaked roguelike about chasing the big win, and what it really costs.

title: Coulrophobia - Pizza Place Demo
description: Play the demo of Coulrophobia: Pizza Place, a first-person psychological horror game set in a small pizzeria. Prepare pizzas, serve customers, and experience a night shift that grows increasingly unsettling as a clown watches the restaurant from outside.

title: Fog & Iron: Broadside - Demo
description: Battleship reimagined as a deep tactical roguelike

title: Eternity Convergence Demo
description: The demo contains a vertical slice of the game allowing the player to progress until the first major story line divides.  A number of the features, such as two player coop, have been disabled for the demo.

title: Grace Demo
description: Grace is a hand-drawn 2D dark fantasy action-metroidvania. Control two rival characters bound by the same destiny: master responsive combat, traverse an interconnected world, and beware your counterpart—if you cross paths and fall in battle, you must switch sides.

title: AMIDA Q Demo
description: AMIDA Q is a high-difficulty amidakuji (ladder lottery) puzzle game. Place pieces to complete the ladder and guide the balls flowing in from the left to their lanes, in the specified order. New gimmicks keep appearing as you progress, making the ladder ever more complex. Dynamic and dramatic.

title: Rage Trip Demo
description: Try Rage Trip for free: three punishing solo levels, plus Shared Fate co-op for 2-4 players where one fall sends everyone back to the start. Dodge saws and spikes while prerecorded voice taunts mock every mistake.

title: You're Absolutely Right! Or: A lovehate game about technology Demo
Operation Night Shift 2 Demo
developer: Htoo Khant Maung, Multi-Games Studio (MUIG Studio)

title: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator Demo
MYTHHUNT Demo
description: Try MYTHHUNT solo or in 1–4 player co-op. Prepare at the lodge, explore the forest, hunt wildlife, scavenge gear, face cryptids and extract alive in this early playable preview.

title: 你就是缘由 Demo
description: Death, redemption, distortion, love, and... you are the reason.

title: PNEUMA Demo
description: Pneuma is an online co-op sci-fi paranormal investigation game for up to 4 players. Operate advanced paranormal tech to investigate, analyze, and outmaneuver deadly ghosts before you are possessed. Speak rituals aloud with your own voice to bind, expose, or provoke what hunts you.

title: しろを塗る Castle Paint Demo
description: This demo lets you play puzzles and paint battles against the CPU. It also supports online multiplayer.In rooms with only demo players, you can face off in paint battles.When a full-version (PlayTest) player is in the room, you can also play the other mini-games together.

title: Gambit Grid Demo
description: The Gambit Grid demo: the full Act I, The Paved Courtyard. Eight floors of battles, elites, merchants and mysteries, ending at the Gatekeeper. One life, every synergy, augments, relics and Crowns. Your Sanctum progress carries over to the full game.

title: Castlefolk Demo
description: A SHORT FIRST LOOK AT CASTLEFOLKThe Castlefolk Demo is a very short introduction to the game, designed to give you around 30 minutes of gameplay.It is not a full sandbox experience.Instead, it is a compact first look at Castlefolk's core systems, atmosphere, and gameplay loop: gathering resources, building your settlement, recruiting...

title: Animal Pong Wild Arena Demo
description: Play as the Cheetah and challenge the Lion AI in Animal Pong Wild Arena! Experience 3 exciting levels, fast-paced arcade gameplay, and special 2X goal power-ups. Score goals, defeat the Lion, and become the champion!

title: Beach Side Chaos Demo
description: Try two complete levels of this British seaside beat ’em up as Chavvy Colin. Punch, kick, grab weapons and unleash specials across the Seaside Strip and the Bird Lady’s Beach. A free single-player demo with no time limit.

title: Remnants of the forsaken Past : Blobbilly the Slime Demo
Departure of Darkness Demo
description: Emma is forced to clear a horrifying parasite-infested airport as she fights to save her brother. In this 90s style Retro Survival Horror, you’ll have the option to save or leave behind fellow survivors during your adventure. However, your choices will have consequences...

title: Shield-Bearer Ben Demo
description: Demo with 4 stages. A short incremental game where you play the TANK in a dungeon-finder party. Hold up your Big Shield, call out the red circles, and keep three teammates alive. Upgrade 120+ skills in a giant skill tree and take down the Demon Lord before tonight's patch deletes his dungeon.

title: Plague Doctor: Apothecary Demo
description: Run your own plague doctor apothecary in this first-person shop simulator. Grind herbs, stir brews, bottle remedies and advise customers. Set prices, count change, hire staff and grow a humble remedy shop into Rookbridge's trusted apothecary.

title: Spaceflight Simulator 2 Graphics Demo
description: Graphics and performance demo for Spaceflight Simulator 2. Explore stunning scenarios from low Earth orbit to the Moon’s surface and test how the game performs on your own device. The demo also includes a full planet editor for creating your own customplanets.

title: Thirst or Bust Demo
description: A free Voyage Survival demo for up to 8 players. Share ship duties, compete for water and supplies, rescue animals, protect a secret ally, and outscore your rival. This demo includes Voyage Survival only; shipboard minigames are planned for later.

title: Sort and Stack! Demo
description: Bring order to chaotic card piles in this fast-paced puzzle game where strategic sorting triggers massive math-based score multipliers and unlocks beautiful handdrawn artwork.

title: SplitOut Demo
description: Split Out - The Ultimate Auto Battle Racing Experience Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in Split Out, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street kart and rise to the global championship glory.

title: CultGame Alpha Demo
description: Create your own cult, perform forbidden rituals, and crusade against the filthy non-believers. It's time to play god. CultGame is a cult simulator RPG where you start your own cult in a procedurally generated fantasy world with haunting ASCII art.

title: 美女不能影响我答题的速度 Demo
BlockBabe Demo
description: She says she isn't interested, yet follows your every move. Meet two anime companions in a flirty match-3 adventure: plan cascades, clear bubbles and unlock linked hearts. Try 20 levels, two bosses, expressive reactions and FEVER bursts in this demo.

title: Love in the Med Pit Demo
description: Sort surgical trays, stock supply drawers and fall for Dr. Shack Abassy, a gruff ER veteran with a soft spot for his emerald-eyed cat. Love in the Med Pit is a cozy medical sorting romance drawn like a 1950s hospital manual. No timers, no rush. Everything has its place.

title: Cubic Trance Demo
description: Trap the cubes before they crush you. A rhythm-puzzle game where rolling waves of cubes dance to the music: lay mines, dodge the forbidden black ones, climb towers and face bosses who fight to the beat of their song. Inspired by I.Q.: Intelligent Qube (PlayStation).

title: Court Vision Demo
description: Run a basketball franchise from the front office. Draft and develop players, negotiate contracts, make trades, and manage lineups. Every decision determines your legacy.

title: Anima Trium Demo
description: In Anima Trium, Leop believes he and his friends may be the last survivors of an ancient war. Until he spots a boat on the horizon. Explore islands and uncover a forgotten past in an adventure RPG full of mystery, featuring turn-based combat with manual and automatic modes.

title: Apex Armada Demo
description: A spaceship auto battler DEMO where you build a fleet and take on real players. Choose an alien captains to lead your fleet into battle. Spend your gold on ships, guns, shields and other parts. Then watch the battles play out as you climb the ranks to become a Galactic Conqueror.

title: Beyond 90: A Footballer's Life Demo
description: Play the first six matches of a footballer’s life. You control only yourself, never the team: earn your shirt, train your skills, sign your first sponsor and live the life off the pitch. Your Demo career carries over into the full game, right where you left it.

title: Respect The Horde Demo
description: You're outnumbered. Outsmart them. Lure hordes of zombies into deadly traps, shape their path with obstacles, and grow stronger with every kill. But know when to walk away before overconfidence and greed turn your strategy into uncontrollable chaos.

title: Time O'clock: The Mask of Crime Demo
description: The mask of a legendary thief has been stolen. Follow Detective Time in a point-and-click investigation using her watch to witness key moments and uncover who is behind this new wave of robberies. Observe the past. Investigate the present. Uncover the truth.

title: One More Shake Demo
description: Shake vending machines, collect cans, earn money and scrap, buy upgrades and automate your progress in this colorful incremental idle game. Keep improving your setup and make every shake count.

title: WarSlice Demo
description: Fight for the glory of battle in WarSlice! Try out some turn-based tactical combat with the demo, which offers both offline campaign missions and online PvP!

title: Legendary Drinking Story Demo
description: Remember that guy from the neighborhood? Relive the stories told over drinks through first-person alley fights. Read your opponent, judge the distance, and play Chapters 1–4 across 32 story encounters.

title: All Machines Must Die Demo
