description: Play solo or grab up to 3 friends for 4-player online co-op and take the city back! Shred hordes of thousands of robots, rip off their parts, hack the big ones and ride them into the crowd. Four kids, one broken key, and a whole city that has to go dark.

title: Beelionair Demo
description: A cozy idle sim about bees and their hives. Plant a wild meadow, send your swarm out to forage, and watch the honey pour in. Grow your hives, breed new bee strains, research upgrades, and re-queen your colony across four biomes. Your hives keep filling up even while you're away.

title: 海特兰世界 Demo
description: Haitland World is a single-player idle RPG that simulates an MMO world. Rule-driven NPCs fight, trade, join guilds and become rivals. Enjoy gear progression, auto-battle and offline rewards. Core gameplay runs locally. Simulated top-ups involve no real money.

title: Scrapecremental Demo
description: Scrape years of gunk off forgotten things with your own fingernail. Every stroke wears your edge down, every flake lands in a jar, and every kind of gunk is its own currency. A short, active incremental about patience, upgrades and what hides underneath.

title: HINEKURE QUEST Demo
description: **Daifugo × RPG!** **HINEKURE QUEST** is a card-battle RPG that combines the rules of Daifugo with RPG elements. Use the cards in your hand to battle enemies, and make use of equipment and skills as you adventure. Enjoy unexpected twists and turns born from simple rules!

title: Sky Motors: Flying Car Factory Demo
Dice On The Rocks Demo
description: Roll physical dice, build hands, and place score-changing stickers on their faces in a roguelike deckbuilder. Upgrade hand levels, collect rule-bending Garnishes, and let the auto-optimal system arrange every effect into your strongest scoring chain.

title: Pierrot Demo
description: Pierrot is a first-person psychological horror set in a twisted theater where a small puppet is trapped in its grasp. Violence is routine and you exist only to obey. Forced to harm others, Pierrot dreams of tearing his strings. Even as the curtain falls his role never ends.

title: Cookiesaner Demo
description: A Balkan bullet-heaven starring Cookie — a real apricot maltipoo. Auto-fire ćevapi, eat baklava, burek and other Balkan foods to chonk up through five belly stages, and hit STAGE 4: GOD MODE. This free demo is the full opening arc: two biomes, three showdowns to chase.

title: Mines and Magic Demo
description: Try Mines and Magic, a fantasy strategy game about building an army, developing your economy, and defending your castle. The demo includes the first three levels of the campaign and multiplayer.

title: Doomsday tidy up Demo
description: Every inch of space matters in the apocalypse. Organize firearms and survival supplies inside your shelter, find a place for every item, and turn cluttered storage into orderly reserves for the days ahead.

title: Rice & Ink: Family Chronicle Demo
description: A clan simulation of the real Jiangnan, 1500–1839: the late Ming, the Qing conquest, laws and dress by the edicts of the year. Lead not a hero but a family: land, exams and office, shops, weddings and funerals, lineage feuds, bandits on the roads. The house must endure.

title: OnlyFarms: Tidy Up Demo
description: Only Farms Tidy Up is a relaxing game about organizing a farm. Arrange 1248 animals. and relax!

title: El Borracho Demo
description: Demo of 2D platformer action-metroidvania "El Borracho". Mexican bandit setting of 50s. Made by a single developer. In this short demo version of the game, you can try out some of the mechanics on one of the game's levels.

title: Skyhold Demo
description: Play the 5 levels of Chapter 1, "Mist Gorge", for free: hold off the first swarms, the bombers and the Bell Jellyfish, and keep the dome intact. The full game has 25 levels in 5 chapters, plus Endless and Challenge modes.

title: Kill The Boss Demo
description: Commander. A boss just walked into your lands. It did not come alone.

title: Sumeru Divine Endeavor Demo
description: Try Sumeru Divine Endeavor, a cultivation and sect management game with no need for constant clicking. Recruit disciples, master mystical arts, collect treasures and forge bonds. Cultivate quietly on your desktop, or switch to immersive mode to focus on your sect.

title: Villa Anzuelo: The Obituarist Demo
description: Try the opening of this illustrated gothic mystery adventure. Explore, examine clues and accompany Francisco to Villa Anzuelo. This free demo ends as you enter the mansion; continue the investigation in the full game.

title: 诡校中学实录 Demo
description: A Strange School: multi‑perspective horror puzzle‑RPG. You are Kaishiniang, trapped in a weird other‑dimensional school. Flee ghosts, avoid traps, solve puzzles. Uncover dark campus legend secrets. Survive and escape the nightmare.

title: Anti-Human: Arcade [New Belleville Demo]
description: Drop into the arena, score as much points as possible by hacking, slashing, shooting and casting while dodging enemy fire and performing stylish kills. Prove your worth, test your skill, and do not forget the most important step: Show off your high score to everyone in ANTI-HUMAN: ARCADE!

title: Treeternal Demo
description: Chop, upgrade, repeat. Venture into a fast-regrowing forest in this top-down incremental roguelite. Draft cards to expand your level-up deck, recruit woodcutter friends, and scale your logging empire to harvest massive amounts of timber.

title: Bird Hockey League Demo
description: Bird Hockey League Ducks, penguins and their feathered friends take their ancient rivalry to the ice. Dangle past defenders, throw wing-breaking hits and snipe your way to the top of the pecking order. Up to 6 players: 3-on-3 couch hockey on one screen, online play, or any mix of the two

title: 分秒之间：发条乐章 Demo
The Prometheus Saga Demo
description: An unknown fleet is approaching, and only one ship can still leave. Build a colony, hold out against the waves in real time, unlock the secrets of xeno technology, then retake the twelve systems of the Road Home one by one, all the way to the homeworld of those who hunt you.

title: Perfumed Palaces Demo
description: Consumer demonstration at 3 weeks from release of the core render stack and gameplay loop of Perfumed Palaces: Purgatory Simulator.

title: CLEAVE Demo
description: CLEAVE is a fast-paced action game where players dodge intense enemy attacks and turn the battlefield to their advantage. Master unique mechanics, overcome challenging obstacles, and push your skills to the limit in this high-intensity experience.

title: StickType Demo
description: Can you evolve from a simple circle to scale a tower and save...well, whoever is crying out for help at the top?

title: Crossroads: Forgotten Paths Demo
description: A light-hearted adventure that whisks you around the micro-fantasy land of Bargvia, join The Mages guild, meet The First Mage, explore The Undercroft, engage with colourful locals and grind in enemy-filled Micro-Dungeons.

title: Everything Must Go! Demo
description: Four broke thieves. One supermarket. One thousand items. Race your friends to steal, sell, and upgrade — then throw groceries at each other until only one thief walks away rich. 4-player online party chaos. Keyboard & mouse.

title: Wheel of Death Demo
description: Spin the wheel... or die. Wheel of Death is a dangerously addictive deck-builder where you'll spin Death's wheel, changing your fate with powerful Tarot card combos, rule-breaking chips, illegal contraband, and a wheel where the numbers go up!

title: Carts & Coins Demo
description: Buy low, sell high, survive the road. Lead a merchant caravan across a hand-drawn fantasy world that is new every run: haggle with elves, dwarves and giants, pack every inch of your cart, and grow rich trading with towns, crowns and the occasional vampire.

title: Noctheria Demo
description: Classic action-adventure dungeons meet survival horror. Explore Albadusk at your own pace, solve cursed dungeons with wit alone, and bring their tools back into the world to reach secrets once out of reach. A dark N64-style adventure of faith, ancient gods, and what hides in the dark.

title: BUNSIK Demo
description: Experience the opening of BUNSIK in this first-person psychological horror demo. Take orders, cook food, clean the Korean snack bar, then walk through an old neighborhood to your rooftop home. An ordinary night shift gradually becomes unsettling.

title: Mr. StoryTeller Demo
description: Discover the first complete story of Mr. StoryTeller in this free demo. Within the reaches of a cosmic library, open the first tome and enter "DON'T DO IT": a loop of psychological horror, liminal apartments, and harrowing choices. Can you break the cycle?

title: BetweenCats Demo
description: Slide cats of all shapes and sizes to leave exactly one empty space in each row and column. Meet 40 adorable cats and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test across 120 challenging levels.

title: Skatebound Demo
description: A first of its kind, action-packed 2.5D skateboarding world where you take full control! Explore the city, find spots to skate, and own the land with hundreds of challenges to conquer both in and out of the camera lens.

title: Put It Away Please Demo
description: “Some Day”: a standalone day made just for the demo. Put the groceries away exactly as the note says, flip the labels to check the dates, and turn around when you hear footsteps behind you. In the full game: five special days of summer break.

title: Mystery House Demo
description: A first and third-person horror revival of Roberta Williams' Mystery House - the 1980 classic that invented the graphic adventure. A game night in an abandoned Victorian House turns deadly. Solve its puzzles, uncover a buried legacy, and escape before the house kills you.

title: Backrooms Anomaly Project Demo
description: Try the demo of Backrooms Anomaly Project, a first-person anomaly horror game. Explore an endless corridor, spot subtle changes in your surroundings, and decide whether to move forward or turn back. Watch out for what's lurking in the dark.

title: Orbit Core Demo
description: Roguelite bullet heaven with mechs: mow down countless robots until you're unstoppable. Absorb their energy, level up, stack modules, unlock items, and combine them into game-breaking builds. And all with an entire planet as your battlefield!

title: Punching a Dirty Wizard Demo
description: The Dirty Demo Wizard wants you to punch him, he wants you to kill him. One strike at a time.

title: Observation Protocol: The Observed Demo
description: A self-contained slice of a first-person psychological horror. Wake inside a facility that watches you, live through one full cycle of its shifting rooms, and reach the demo's own ending. Roughly 50–60 minutes. Slow, atmospheric, and meant to be paid attention to. English only.

title: Penance Demo
description: Searching for his missing wife, Calen awakens in a place that feels both familiar and wrong. As night falls, terrifying creatures emerge. Hide, fight strategically, and solve puzzles to survive the shifting nightmare and uncover the truth.

title: Starets Demo
description: Starets is a narrative walking sim set in the historical context of 14th-century Rus, in the lands of the Principality of Tver. Nikodim, a former princely scribe, is on his way to a monastery.

title: 「認識」/RECOGNIZED Demo
description: An analog-horror soulslike where you fight infamous internet emoji memes. When the smiling windmill stops spinning and every finger points at you, run. Swing an umbrella, throw empty cans, and survive one night recorded on a 2011 tape.

title: Cherry Pick Demo
description: Open packs to collect a variety of shrimp, then breed them to discover even rarer ones. Decorate your own aquarium and watch your shrimp slowly grow in this cozy pixel-art game.

title: Terminal Drift Demo
description: Hold down the cargo bay! In Terminal Drift, automated defense systems handle the trigger, but survival is entirely in your hands. Adapt your load-out and survive 20 relentless waves, because when the Matriarch breaches the hull, firepower alone won’t save you.

title: INANIMA Demo
description: A survival horror game set in the isolated facilities of a strange corporation. Search for limited supplies, and fight terrifying creatures to reveal the truth behind the Lazarus project. Be part of something that will change the future of humanity.

title: Wavie Wavie Demo
description: An impossible parking lot. A recurring anomaly. A greeting that could change everything. Explore, observe, and interact with Wavie Wavie in a first-person symbolic horror experience where every loop hides new secrets.

title: Pine Creek Demo
description: Your wife has vanished. Her pager signal leads you to an abandoned water plant on the outskirts of Pine Creek. You are not alone inside. Solve puzzles, hide from the grays and escape the facility in this stealth survival horror demo set in rural Pennsylvania, 1986.

title: Simple Card TCG Craft Demo
description: ·自定义卡牌外观和功能设计·将设计好的卡牌导出为PNG·导入或手机扫描其他玩家的PNG卡牌，可识别其卡牌效果·支持本地双人对战和联网对战功能·支持9种语言·试用版不支持导出功能

title: SEND MORE GRUNTS! Demo
description: A gory, satirical rogue-autobattler. Your grunts fight on their own: you pick where, gear them up and recruit more, turning four nervous riflemen into an exploding horde. High Command always wants more.

title: Our Little Cinema Demo
description: A cozy 2D job sim where you run the ticket booth of a small-town cinema! Play through the first 3 days, take orders on your tablet, seat customers by their traits, handle cash and card payments, restock snacks, and choose which movies play tomorrow. Keep your guests happy and earn those tips! 🎬🍿💕

title: Hotel of Seams Demo
description: October 1997. Your grandfather’s lakeside hotel is yours now: a diner, rooms to manage, and two cats. Cook meals and serve your customers, hand out keys to guests, and keep everything clean. Some of the people who check in are not human, and nobody is going to tell you which ones.

title: Night Shift at the Cement Plant Demo
description: Cement is in high demand and you’ve just landed a night shift job at a desert cement plant. Operate locomotives, load train cars, and keep the conveyors running. Sounds chill for 35 bucks an hour, right? Better hope your coworkers are joking about skinwalkers moving out in the yard after dark!

title: Brick by Brick: Build and Play Demo
Avalon: Legacy Edition Demo
description: Try the free demo of Avalon: Legacy Edition. Explore a distant world, face dangerous creatures and discover the first secrets of this classic 2D RPG, faithfully recreated by its original makers for modern systems.

title: Infernal West Demo
description: Infernal West is a first-person psychological horror puzzle game set in a Wild West saloon. Observe every detail, identify the anomalies warping reality, and unravel the mysteries hidden within an endless loop. Every decision may bring you closer to the exit... or trap you in the loop forever.

title: Pro Endurance Series: Running Manager Demo
description: Experience the Berlin 10K in 3D! Control one of three athletes with different goals, manage your pace, attack, take refreshments, and make tactical decisions in real time. Can you lead your runner to success?

title: Dinolords Multiplayer Demo
description: Build your stronghold, command human and dinosaur armies and fight alongside your troops. Try Dinolords’ blend of real-time strategy, city-building and action RPG combat in this multiplayer demo, with a selection of maps and battles for up to 8 players.

title: Netherworld: Blood Moon Demo
description: You wake up shackled to a bamboo stalk in an unfamiliar forest. In the distance, something seems to be moving through the grove. You look closer... until you realize... it isn’t alive at all. One bizarre and horrifying event follows another. Under unbearable pressure, can you find a way out alive?

title: Conveyor Crew Demo
description: A 1970s analog horror where you descend into a dark 3D warehouse to scavenge parts for your conveyor puzzles while something stalks you in the shadows. Think harder to risk less, risk more to think less. At Ironside, your survival is just a bonus.

title: Last Light Demo
description: Elias is an ordinary night recovery worker sent into abandoned and dangerous locations. Equipped with only a flashlight, backpack, and basic tools, he must explore, complete objectives, hide from supernatural creatures, manage limited resources, and survive long enough to escape.

title: One-Time Trigger Demo
description: Carefully observe the seven patients. Identify the one who doesn't belong, fire your one and only bullet, and complete the test. Shoot the wrong one and you die. You get only one chance.

title: No Dead Ends Demo
description: You died. Congratulations! Now you’re at the No Dead Ends Bar, and the Barman owns your soul. The price for freedom? $1,000,000. Gamble with the deceased, beat their games, and buy back your soul!

title: Beeline Demo
description: Slash and dash through tens of thousands of enemies per run in this action roguelite. Call in the hive for support, wield up to five weapons, evolve devastating builds, and combine powerful abilities. Rescue unique bees, build your Hive, and restore your bee kingdom to survive the forces of nature.

title: The Ninth Witch’s Jail Demo
description: The Ninth Witch's Jail is an anomaly-hunt game with a crunchy retro aesthetic set in the Medieval era. Spot the signs of curses or witchcraft in the prison to break out of an endless loop, continue your exploration and confront the ninth witch.

title: 피지컬 윷놀이 데모
description: A real-time take on the Korean board game Yut. Throw as your energy fills, collect rolls, stack your pieces, and capture opponents. Choose your timing and race to bring all four pieces home, with three AI difficulty levels to practice against.

title: Floating Realm：LoFi Demo
description: Build your own peaceful little world! Floating Realm: LoFi wraps your floating sanctuary in gentle LoFi melodies, letting you freely craft your aerial scenes. Adorable pets stay by your side, with quick notes, to-do lists and Pomodoro focus timer. Settle into quiet, solo immersion for deep focus.

title: LEVELS Demo
description: Explore the first true open-world Backrooms: one infinite, procedurally generated world full of unique biomes, shared by every online player. (And the entities live here too!)

title: Dajimo Arena: Team Showdown Demo
description: Multiplayer arena FPS, no lobby: drop straight into a live match. 1 arena, 4 team colors w/ distinct play styles, abilities + weapons. 6+ players unlock the lethal Outskirts where new weapons await discovery! Developed with Memsight runtime intelligence. Runs on GONet Legendary. Thanks Galore!

title: Hypernet Explorer Demo
description: Roguelike immersive sim set in esoteric post Y2K Europe.

title: Framed Demo
description: Finland, 1992. The Black Cross biker gang frames the Salmela brothers for murder. In 1998 they get out of prison and go after revenge. The demo has the campaign's prologue and the endless Farm defense mode. Co-op shooter: split screen, online or solo.

title: MURK Demo
description: A bone wrenching blend of brutal melee and ranged combat. MURK is atmospheric combat horror in first person where you fight nightmarish creatures emerging from below. Survive against all odds in the vicious battle against the earth reclaiming itself.

title: Ritual Chamber Demo
description: It's 1978 and Mara Venn cleans the treatment rooms at a private clinic, nights only. The register says Chamber Six is empty. There's someone in the chair. A first-person psychological horror game about a job you can't afford to lose.

title: BULLACATOR Demo
description: A free demo of BULLACATOR. Try the first area of this coin pusher × roguelite × deckbuilder for free. Drop your shells, smash enemies with physics, and build a deck all your own.

title: OverDoze Demo
description: All Dasha wants is to get some sleep and finish watching her favorite dream. But in a crime‑ridden metropolis ruled by organized crime groups and corporations, that turns into an unattainable dream.

title: Tamagong Demo
description: A monster-raising autobattler where you hatch, feed, and train your monsters, shape their builds, and discover powerful team synergies.

title: Last Signal Demo
description: Plan the perfect infiltration. Route a stealth robot past patrols and cameras, hack terminals, operate machinery, and manipulate the environment to create your path. Then execute your plan and watch it play out. Every decision matters.

title: Mannequin: Echoes of Their Minds Demo
description: Work the night shift at a clothing store, dressing mannequins according to instructions. Your job lasts 30 days. With every mistake, the store grows stranger. Unexplained anomalies keep appearing. Can you make it through all 30 days? A job simulator horror game where quiet work meets creeping dread.

title: EscapeFromSeoul Demo
description: Explore two districts of a sealed-off Seoul in this single-player ASCII extraction survival demo. Fight, loot, upgrade your gear and hideout, and make it back alive. Import your demo progress into the full game.

title: LimeFlesh Demo
description: Humanity has melted into a massive, living mass of flesh. Born from a drop of blood at the bottom of this nightmare, you must push living walls, carve tunnels, and gather resources to escape. A short, tense body horror experience.

title: Lusty Tavern Rush Demo
description: Inherit a gutted tavern and build it back. A first-person adult management sim where you pour ale, chase raised hands across a crowded floor, upgrade every room you own, and hire three women worth more than their wages.

title: Twisted Childhood Demo
description: Remember the fairy tales you grew up with? Start corrupting them. This demo opens five tales, five different games, and Wishes to bend their rules. Criquet is already waiting for you...

title: LIDVN Demo
description: Explore LIDVN and experience parts of three adventures.

title: Raid Sky Demo
description: Fly your island, fish, craft, build cannons and unleash debuffs on bot rivals in 15-minute matches. Offline singleplayer only, Easy / Normal / Hard AI. Three ways to score: crystal charge, bonus zone and missions.

title: Penko Vox: Japanese Demo
description: Free demo of Penko Vox: Japanese. Start your voyage in Hajimari Town: talk to residents in your own words, call them by voice, catch word spirits on Route 1 and get gentle corrections, all fully offline on your PC. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Lunar Mining Demo
description: Try Lunar Mining for free! Mine ores, upgrade your gear through the Forge and Skills tree, and push through the Surface biome up to level 15, all the way to your first boss fight against the Lunar Worm.

title: ドリイ —stairway to heaven— Demo
description: DORII is a psychological horror visual novel about an illegal human cloner who receives an unusual request: recreate a dead son. Raise a human life, confront unsettling truths, and discover what it means to be human. Experience the beginning of the story in this free demo.

title: Chroma Demo
description: Try the complete first level of Chroma, a roguelike deckbuilder. Combine six elements, recruit mages, and use elemental parchments to reach the target score and defeat the boss. Start another run to discover new synergies.

title: Meow Game: Desert Island Survival Demo
PANIC POST Demo
description: Deliver the package. Even if it fights back. Team up with 2–4 players for five space-delivery missions in the PANIC POST demo. Throw, catch and haul cargo together, dodge station hazards, and chase living parcels before the shift goes sideways.

title: Mogilev: Apocalypse Demo
description: All missions 1–7 in a free demo.Experience the current opening of Mogilev: Apocalypse, a single-player, first-person survival game. The demo takes place inside Tadas’s locked club in central Mogilev.Meet Natasa and Erika, play Durak for in-game gold, buy water and canned food, and manage hunger, thirst and sleep.

title: Hopwood Demo
description: A cozy 2D metroidvania about memory. In this free demo, explore the first two connected regions, learn to punch, roll and double jump, use the Whisper to hear what creatures think, and win back two blossoms of the Old Cherry from bosses who forgot who they are.

title: Dungeonmancer Demo
description: A solo action-exploration dungeon crawler about defeating monsters, collecting loot, and overcoming bosses.

title: Soccer Ball Simulator Demo
description: A concussed referee wakes up as a soccer ball. Real physics at soccer ball scale plus one super powered boost. Climb, jump and bash your way through the halls of your subconscious to put an end to the evil referee rigging the sport.

title: Overarmed Survivors Demo
description: Try the free demo of this mech arena roguelite. Unlock 5 mechs and 23 weapon forms, evolve your arsenal, and fight through the Hangar. Play solo or with up to three friends in online or local co-op. Dodge bosses and build something overpowered.

title: Super Pilot Yolk Bot Demo
description: Smash through relentless waves of enemies as a high-speed Float Bot! Build momentum, grab upgrades, and push your luck for bigger rewards. Extract in time or lose it all as you chase powerful builds and stronger bots.

title: Candy Factory Demo
description: Build a candy factory on a cake island floating in the clouds. Mould candies, flavour them, top them and send them by road to the Candy Carousel. Chain 59 works into ever sweeter recipes, spin the reward machine, weather gumball storms and sugar quakes, and finish the carousel in five ages.

title: Heatline Demo
description: Choose your side in Most Wanted, an asymmetric open-world racer. Evade the law as a fugitive or command the police to hunt them down. A dynamic 1-10 star wanted system escalates from patrol cars to air support. Tune fifty-plus vehicles, hit the nitrous, and own the streets.

title: Core0 Demo
description: Core0 blends incremental defense with auto-battling combat. Deploy units, combine automatic weapons, and turn each run into permanent upgrades. Experiment with builds and withstand increasingly fierce attacks.

title: Dragon Kingdom Demo
description: Restore a forgotten farm, raise a Baby Dragon, grow crops, face changing weather, explore the mine, and begin bringing the kingdom back to life in this focused demo of Dragon Kingdom.

title: Liberate: Escape Room for Two Demo
Statto Complete Basketball Demo
description: Take control of your own basketball world where you are the head coach, general manager, and commissioner!

title: Maze Heroes Demo
description: Theseus followed Ariadne’s thread, slew the Minotaur, and became a legend. A century later, monsters have returned to the night roads of Crete. Lead a hero and one companion into the ancient maze, solve its puzzles, survive its battles, and uncover the truth buried beneath a forgotten legend.

title: Degrees of Love ~ Beyond Eternal Promise ~ Demo
description: This is a story about fulfilling a promise made before birth. A guidepost for the journey home—reclaiming the time lost by fulfilling the promise the two made in the past. At the end of a journey spanning countless years, with an eternal promise in their hearts.

title: やけくそ異界エレベータ Demo
Soraseed Desktop 2026 Demo
description: Try Soraseed Desktop 2026 with free flight and a scored square-route exercise for Second-Class practical flight skills. Explore POS mode, map and pilot views, and input settings.

title: Point Nemo Demo
description: You're a commercial diver left under an offshore platform after an accident. The only way up is a chain of emergency refuges, and each one needs a part from out in the dark. You get a bearing, six strobes and a few minutes of gas. Your supervisor, Mara, stays on the radio.

title: Counterplayed Demo
description: Online co-op roguelite for 1 to 4 players: swap between five elemental weapons to chain vulnerabilities, send damage soaring with no cap at all and survive 20 waves of machines that adapt to your weapons.

title: Hall of Minds Demo
description: Enter the minds of your patients and explore disturbing worlds shaped by trauma, fear, and buried secrets.

title: The Shadow Crown - Frostwynd Chronicles Demo
description: Play Act 1 of The Shadow Crown free. Explore Eldergrove village and the Dark Forest, battle goblins, bandits and corrupted beasts, and find the key to the iron door beneath the ancient ruins. A retro text adventure in the spirit of the 1980s classics.

title: DEGUL DEGUL 999 Demo
description: Try 45 rolling logic puzzles from the 999 campaign: five from each of nine difficulty sections. Plan your route and landing faces, undo freely, and sample puzzles with a single cube, a long block, and two interacting blocks.

title: Benson Bones Demo
description: You claw out of a grave with no memory, and a friendly dog named Benson finds you. Benson Bones is a top-down pixel art adventure RPG with timing-based combat, Souls-style checkpoints and a hand-built world of doors that open where they shouldn't.

title: SLASH//SYNC Demo
description: SLASH//SYNC is a rhythm action game where your mouse movement becomes the blade. Slice notes racing down five lanes from the indicated direction. Chase high scores and full combos as every slash bursts into light, and experience the thrill of perfect synchronization—all with a mouse.

title: CODEX : RECALL 图灵之书 Demo
description: CODEX : RECALL is a single-player PvE strategy card game that combines 2.5D exploration, deckbuilding, tactical grid movement, and fragmented storytelling. Explore The World of Codex, restore Mind Spaces corrupted by breaches, and uncover the truth behind you, Lipa, and this world.

title: Vampine: New Order Demo
description: Awaken to a world ruled by the Intelligences and reclaim your honor! A turn-based strategy roguelike deckbuilder where you lead a vampire rebellion, bonds powerful servants, craft tactical card decks, and combine unique abilities to outsmart your enemies.

title: Illusionary Manor Demo
description: Illusionary Manor Demo is an early prototype offering a small glimpse into the full game. It introduces the core magic brush mechanic, lets you enter the first painting, and features a brief encounter with one of the manor’s characters. This demo represents only a small part of the experience currently in development.

title: Hauntbound Demo
description: An online and local multiplayer horror party game for 2 to 8 players. Explore a haunted house that builds itself, search for relics, avoid deadly traps, and compete in chaotic minigames before the haunt begins.

title: Rollamon Demo
description: Raise one monster on your stat sheet. Draft dice, spend XP, race for Arena Medals, and win on Contest Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

title: Bandidos em Brasilia Demo
description: Demo of Bandidos em Brasília. This demo includes the story mode and the free modes! Try out a horror game featuring Brazil's most well-known politicians for free, and feel free to report any bugs or suggest improvements!

title: TIC.EXE Demo
description: The TIC.EXE demo: four of the eight sectors. Three in a row is not a win, it is a discharge — the line detonates into the hostile process. Build a deck and modules, reach the boss.

title: Aveos Demo
description: Rediscover the classic feel of linear ARPGs in Aveos! Explore four unique levels with multiple stages, hundreds of unique items, and ongoing quest updates! Explore the world, find your own play style, and take on challenges alone or with friends in a new, unusual world.

title: No One Left To Die Demo
On Time In Full Demo
description: OTIF puts you in front of the whiteboard. You have a kanban board, a team, a budget, and a deadline. The client wants it On Time, In Full. How you get there is up to you.

title: 樱华退魔录 Demo
description: The free demo of Ouka Exorcists: Night Parade. Play 4 exorcist girls, all 20 waves of Stage 1 with the Nine-Tails final boss, the prologue, each heroine's first episode and the shrine hub. Your progress carries over to the full version.

title: Down to Floor Zero Demo
description: Down to Floor Zero is a survival horror experience set in an unreasonably large hotel. Your only means of transportation is an elevator that can solely go down. Each floor may host useful items and structures, as well as horrors beyond comprehension. Try to reach the ground floor… intact.

title: Gridbound Demo
description: GRIDBOUND is a co-op arcade action game on a shifting LED floor. Dodge red hazards, activate blue objectives, and reach green safe tiles. Coordinate with your teammates, react fast, and stay alive as the grid changes around you.

title: Echo Pandemic Demo
description: Earth needs antibodies. You are one of them. Play as a bat who hunts by echolocation, infects alien invaders with engineered diseases, and stays one mutation ahead in a desperate biological war for the planet.

title: Pride City Demo
description: Step into Pride City, where fabulous superheroes, everyday drama, and queer chaos collide! Explore Pride city, discover your powers, build relationships, and experience a first taste of a superhero life where being yourself is the greatest power of all.

title: The Lost Within II Demo
description: You are trapped in dark, abandoned mines where your only way out is to run. Solve puzzles, avoid deadly traps, and try to survive while a bloodthirsty monster hunts you down in every corner. Can you make it to the light?

title: The Oink: Prelude
description: Existential horror about free will. Perform daily livestock slaughter and explore the environment in search of the truth. ESCAPE OR ██████

title: Real Zombie Survivors Demo
description: Real Zombie Survivors is a co-op top-down arena shooter where you fight relentless hordes of zombies on real-world maps generated from OpenStreetMap data. Choose unique classes, upgrade your arsenal, call in combat robots, and survive the apocalypse solo or with friends on Steam!

title: Witch Please! Demo
description: Help Petra navigate her new life as Head Witch of Fenloft Academy! Juggle classes, train skills, make friends, and solve mysteries in this charming choose-your-own-adventure-style visual novel.

title: What We Leave Behind Demo
description: Survive an Alaskan winter in this single-player demo. Gather wood, keep the cabin warm, prepare food and improve the refuge. Each survivor's skills die with them; their physical work can help the next life. You will die. What you build will remain.

title: PAYDIRT: Gold Mining Tycoon Demo
description: Build your first mining camp in this free First Crew demo. Start with hand tools and no cash, pan and sell your first gold, improve your tools and hire a helper. Choose a man or woman prospector, bring Pepper and keep exploring after the first-crew milestone.

title: Society Ciphers: The Invisible Man Demo
description: Vanish from sight in this third-person stealth shooter as you infiltrate enemy strongholds, evade guards using dynamic detection meters, execute silent takedowns, and stop the Reapers' plans.

title: SYSTEM INTRUDER Demo
description: Explore the dark secrets of ASGARD-04 in a retro-cyberpunk survival horror inspired by classic 3D games. Search for clues, solve puzzles, fight enemies, manage limited resources, and survive the horrors lurking within a mysterious research complex.

title: After Frame Demo
description: Some things can only be seen through the camera. The longer you look, the more clearly they see you. Can you uncover the truth before something notices you? A first-person psychological horror game built around paranormal investigation and unseen anomalies.

title: The Death Deliriant Prologue
description: The Death Deliriant Prologue is a first-person survival horror game that blends cosmic horror with realistic mechanics and tells the story of the corpse, who is also the first victim in the main game, Find items to escape while evading enemies, complete mechanical tasks while facing terror.

title: Saltwater Bodies Demo
description: Saltwater Bodies is a cave-diving body horror game.Explore underwater cave systems beneath a salt flat, and nurture an unnatural vessel away from prying eyes.Features a physics-based caving system where you have to be mindful of positioning your body parts, and balance that against holding your breath underwater - Is it worth breathing...

title: Triogram Demo
description: Triogram is a cosy puzzle game where three flat Nonogram grids come together to reveal a 3D object. Use the number clues to work out its front, top and side silhouettes and watch the model take shape.

title: The Hanging Game Demo
description: Hangman was a children's game on paper. Here, you don't draw the hanged man — you are him. Search an abandoned graveyard for letter stones, carry them to the altar, and spell the word before seven mistakes tighten the noose.

title: TRI CHAPAS Demo
description: Play the free demo of Tri Chapas: 10 levels of tactical, physics-based coin football for 2 players. Flick one disc between the other two without touching them, stay onside and push toward the goal. Plan the pass. Score the goal.

title: HOSHIKUI Demo
description: Try the free demo of HOSHIKUI, an action roguelite with no attack button. You are a dying star: ramming other stars is how you attack, heal, move, and grow. Steal their heat and outrun the heat death of the universe.

title: No Prospects Demo
description: Build railways deep into monster-infested caves in this online co-op horror game. Work together to mine valuable ore, fill your minecart, and upgrade your equipment as you venture into increasingly dangerous depths.

title: Put the Ball in the Hole Demo
description: The instructions are in the title. You have a ball. You see a hole. Put the ball there.

title: Mini Legends Idle Demo
description: Try Mini Legends Idle, a voxel fantasy idle RPG with automatic combat. Farm loot, level up, upgrade weapons and armor and combine passives as you progress through stage.

title: In Print Demo
description: In Print is a chaotic rogue-lite shooter where each round’s loser picks a new power-up to build a unique combo. Rain fire with the power of Hellvetica or fly through the skies with Wingdings. All while sporting your finest office attire.

title: The Good Stuff: Story of a True Hero - Demo
description: A short game demo for The Good Stuff.

title: がむしゃらギルド-Scrappy Guild- Demo
description: Team up with your friends, pool your wisdom, and take on the Demon King with the ultimate deck. Gamashira Guild is a cooperative deck-building roguelike where discussing strategies with friends is the key to victory. Let’s all team up and take down the Demon King!

title: Fallen City Demo
description: Free demo of an isometric zombie shooter: fight through hordes of the dead, upgrade your guns and burn the crimson out of a blacked-out town. The first 5 chapters of each of the three stories, plus Survival and Night Shift.

title: Goblin And Glory Demo
description: Build your goblin crew, upgrade your sword, and fight through 10 dungeons! Goblin & Glory is a pixel-art clicker game with auto-attacking helpers, relic choices, and 60-second boss battles. Earn prestige, unlock permanent abilities, and return stronger with every run.

title: Skylane: Airline Tycoon Simulator Demo
description: Run an airline the competent way you wish they were like in real life. Open routes, buy aircraft, build the weekly schedule, and hire crew qualified to fly it. No cockpits, no cutscenes. Just the network, the numbers, and fierce rivals aiming to take a cut of your market share.

title: Snake Echos Demo
description: Snake, rebuilt as a survivors-like. Auto-firing abilities, level-up picks, and an arena that gets deadlier every level — falling blocks, lasers, collapsing floors. Your own trail is your best weapon and your worst enemy. One run. One score. The whole world watching.

title: TDoom Demo
description: Free demo. Earth has fallen and the last rocket carrying humanity is waiting to launch. Deploy tanks, fighter jets and helicopters around the Ark, hit start and hold off the horde across the first 3 sectors. Every defeat earns credits for the skill tree. Come back stronger.

title: SEAMARK Demo
description: Chart your own course in SEAMARK, a maritime adventure of sailing, trading, and naval combat. Visit port towns, buy and sell goods, and command your ship in battle. Discover the world and core gameplay in this demo featuring a portion of the full game.

title: Swift Cultivation Demo
description: Swift Cultivation is a text-based idle game. Set your action queue, and let time do the rest: auto-breakthrough when cultivation is maxed, eat when HP is low. Die, and you'll reincarnate stronger. Idle from Qi Refining Layer 1 to Spirit Transformation Layer 10, and ascend!

title: 記帳戦隊 Demo
description: The demo of Kichou Sentai. Play Episode 1, "The Back Alley," all the way through. As Tsukasa, field commander of the evil Chojirikai, get a feel for a turn-based tactics game where every move enters the ledger. Episodes 2 and 3 continue in the full game.

title: ScarryLand: The Potion Goes Wrong! Demo
description: Your grandfather’s potion went horribly wrong. Animals behave like humans, humans have turned into animals, and your grandfather has left. Until he returns, find a potion and put it in the tea stall to cure the chaos for a short time, with Bonky!

title: Soul Gathering Demo
description: Every card is both your sword and your shield—but each use wears it down until it crumbles to nothing. Seven classes, a deck that decays, and enemies hungry for souls. Reach the heart of a collapsing world with whatever cards you have left. A roguelike deck-building card battler.

title: Still Not Dead Yet: The Demo
